6.1.1.e: In this अधिकार the doubling happens for the first एकाच् entity of the verb

6.1.2.e: The द्वित्व mandated in the <<एकाचो द्वे प्रथमस्य>> [[6.1.1]] अधिकार happens for the second एकाच् component of an अनेकाच् अजादि word.

6.1.3.a: द्वितीयस्य एकाचः संयोगादयः न्द्राः न द्वे
6.1.3.e: When doubling of an अनेकाच् अजादि  verb root is to be done, the नकार, दकार, and रेफ present at the beginning of a संयोग are not duplicated.

6.1.4.e: When a repetition is done, the first entity out of the two is called अभ्यास.

6.1.5.e: When the doubling happens in this अधिकार, the two copies are collectively referred as 'अभ्यस्त'.

6.1.6.e: The verb roots belonging to the जक्षित्यादिगण are called 'अभ्यस्त'.

6.1.7.e: In the room of a short vowel of the Reduplicate of the the roots तुज् etc., a long is substituted.

6.1.8.a: लिटि धातोः अनभ्यासस्य एकाचः प्रथमस्य, अजादेः द्वितीयस्य द्वे
6.1.8.e: When followed by a प्रत्यय of लिट् लकार,  a verb root that have not yet undergone द्वित्वम् undergoes द्वित्वम्.

6.1.9.e: When followed by the सन्-प्रत्यय or the  यङ्-प्रत्यय, a verb root that have not yet undergone द्वित्वम् undergoes द्वित्वम्.

6.1.10.e: When a प्रत्यय is removed using the word श्लु, अङ्ग which is not yet duplicated is duplicated.

6.1.11.e: When followed by the चङ्-प्रत्यय, a verb root that have not yet undergone द्वित्वम् undergoes द्वित्वम्.

6.1.12.e: The participles दाश्वाम् , साह्वान् , and मीढ्वान् are irregularly formed without reduplication.

6.1.13.e: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel य् of the affix ष्यङ् [[4.1.78]] when followed in a तत्-पुरुष compound, by the words पुत्र and पति।

6.1.14.e: There is vocalisation of the affix ष्यङ् [[4.1.78]] when the word बन्धु follows in a बहुव्रीही compound.

6.1.15.e: The semi-vowels of the roots वच् , स्वप् , and यजादि verbs are vocalised when followed by an affix having an indicatory क।

6.1.16.e: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowels of the following verbs, when an affix having an indicatory क् or ङ् follows - ग्रह 'to take', ज्या 'to become old', वेञ् 'to weave', व्यध 'to strike', वश 'to shine', व्यच 'to deceive', व्रश्च 'to cut', प्रच्छ 'to ask' and भ्रस्ज 'to cook, to fry'.

6.1.17.e: There takes place a vocalisation of the semi-vowels of the reduplicate (अभ्यास) of both वाच्यादि [[6.1.15]] and ग्रहादि [[6.1.16]] words, when affixes of लिट् follow.

6.1.18.e: Of the causative verb स्वपि 'to cause one to sleep', there is vocalisation of the semi-vowel, when the affix चङ् of the Reduplicated Aorist follows.

6.1.19.e: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel, of the verbs स्वप् 'to sleep', स्यम् 'to shout' and व्ये 'to cover', when followed by the affix यङ् of the Intensive.

6.1.20.e: There is not vocalisation of the semi-vowel of वश्, when the affix यङ् follows.

6.1.21.e: The verb की is substituted for the verb चायृ 'to worship, to observe', when the Intensive affix यङ् follows.

6.1.22.e: The स्फी is the substitute of स्फाय 'to swell', the निष्ठा affixes follow.

6.1.23.e: The verb स्त्या (स्त्यै and ष्ठ्यै) when preceded by प्र changes its semi-vowel to a vowel, when a निष्ठ affix follows.

6.1.24.e: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel of the root श्या (श्यै) 'to go' when the निष्ठा affix follows, when the sense is 'coagulation' or 'cold to touch'.

6.1.25.e: There is vocalisation of श्या preceded by the उपसर्ग प्रति , when the निष्ठा affixes follow.

6.1.26.e: There is optionally the vocalisation of the श्या followed by निष्ठा affixes, when the उपसर्गs अभि and अव precede it.

6.1.27.e: Optionally शृत is formed in the sense of 'cooked', by the vocalisation of the semi-vowel of आ before the निष्ठा affix क्त।

6.1.28.e: पी is optionally the substitute of the root प्याय् 'to increase' before the निष्ठा affixes.

6.1.29.e: There is substitution of पी for प्याय् when the affixes of the Perfect (लिट्) and the Intensive (यङ्) follow.

6.1.30.e: There is optionally the vocalisation of the semi-vowel श्वि before the affixes of the Perfect and the Intensive.

6.1.31.e: There is optionally the vocalisation of the semi-vowel, in the causative of श्वि , when followed by the Desiderative सन् and the Aorist चङ् affix.

6.1.32.e: There is the vocalisation of the semi-vowel of the causative of ह्वे before the Desiderative and the Reduplicated Aorist affixes.

6.1.33.e: In the छन्दस् , the semi-vowel of this root is diversely vocalised.

6.1.34.e: For चाय् is diversely substituted की in the छन्दस्।

6.1.35.e: In the छन्दस् the following irregular forms are met with - अस्पृधेथाम् , आनृचुः , आनृहुः , चिच्युषे , तित्याज , श्राताः , श्रितम् , आशीः , आशीर्त्तः।

6.1.36.e: When a semi-vowel base has been vocalised, there is no vocalisation of the other semi-vowel that may precede it in the same word.

6.1.37.e: In the substituted root वय [[2.4.41]], the य in the Perfect is not vocalised.

6.1.38.e: Before the tense-affixes of the Perfect that have an indicatory क [[1.2.5]], for the य् of वय् may optionally be substituted a व्।

6.1.39.e: The semi-vowel of वे 'to weave' is not vocalised in the Perfect.

6.1.40.e: The semi-vowel of वे 'to weave' is not vocalised in the Participial affix ल्यप् follows.

6.1.41.e: The semi-vowel of ज्या 'to grow old' is not vocalised when the affix ल्यप् follows.

6.1.42.e: The semi-vowel of व्या (व्ये) 'to cover' is not vocalised when the affix ल्यप् follows.

6.1.43.e: The vocalisation may optionally take place when व्ये preceded by परि takes the affix ल्यप्।

6.1.44.e: In a root, which in the system of grammatical instruction (i.e. the धातुपाठ), ends with a diphthong (ए , ऐ , ओ, औ), there is the substitution of आ for the diphthong, provided that no affix with an indicatory श् follows it.

6.1.45.e: There is not the substitution of आ for the diphthong of the root व्ये when the affixes of the Perfect follow.

6.1.46.e: In the roots स्फुर् and स्फुल् 'to move', there is the substitution of the आ for the diphthong when the affix घञ् follows.

6.1.47.e: The substitution of आ for the diphthong takes place in the causatives of the roots क्री 'to buy, to purchase', इ 'to study' and जि 'to conquer'.

6.1.48.e: The substitution of आ takes for the diphthong in the causative of सिध् , when it does not refer to the next life.

6.1.49.e: And there is substitution of आ for the finals of मी 'to hurt', मि 'to scatter' and दी 'to decay' when the affix ल्यप् follows, as well as before those affixes which demand this substitution for the diphthong.

6.1.50.e: There is optionally the substitution of आ for the final of ली 'to adhere', in the धातुपाठ , when the affix ल्यप् follows or such an affix as would demand this substitution of the diphthong.

6.1.51.e: There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the diphthong of the verb खिद् 'to suffer pain', in the छन्दस्।

6.1.52.e: There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the diphthong of the root गुर् 'to exert' when preceded by the preposition अप and taking the affix णमुल्।

6.1.53.e: There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the diphthong of the roots चि and स्फुर् when in the Causative.

6.1.54.e: There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the diphthong of the root वी in the causative, when meaning 'to conceive an embryo'.

6.1.55.e: There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the diphthong of the root भी 'to fear' in the causative, when the fear is produced directly through the agent of the causative.

6.1.56.e: There is invariably the substitution of आ for the diphthong of the root स्मि 'to smile' in the causative, when the astonishment is produced directly through the agent of the causative.

6.1.57.e: The augment अम् (अ) comes after the ऋ or सृज् 'to create' and दृश् 'to see', when an affix beginning with a झल् letter (the Mute and the Sibilant) follows: provided that it has no indicatory क।

6.1.58.e: The augment अम् (अ) augment comes optionally after the ऋ of those roots which are exhibited in the धातुपाठ as अनुदात्त , when such roots end in a consonant having a ऋ has penultimate and are followed by an affix beginning with a mute or sibilant and not having an indicatory क।

6.1.59.e: The word शीर्षन् 'head', is found in छन्दस्।

6.1.60.e: There is the substitution of this stem शीर्षन् for शिरस् when a तद्धित-affix beginning with य follows.

6.1.61.e: The आदेशाs पद्,दत्,नस्, मास्, हृत्, निश्, असन्, यूषन्, दोषन्, यकन्, शकन्, उदन्, आसन् are created (to the appropriate words) in presence शस् and other विभक्तिs from तृतीया onwards.

6.1.62.e: A षकार present at the beginning of औपदेशिक  form of a धातु is converted to सकार.

6.1.63.e: A णकार present at the beginning of औपदेशिक form of a धातु is converted to नकार.

6.1.64.e: A वकार and a यकार are deleted when followed by a letter of the वल् प्रत्याहार.

6.1.65.e: The प्रत्यय 'वि' is removed when it appears अपृक्त.

6.1.66.e: The सुँ, ति, or सि प्रत्यय, when present as a single letter, is removed when attached to - (1) a word ending in a  हल् letter,  or (2) A दीर्घ word ending in the  ङीप् / ङीष् / ङीन् / चाप् / टाप् / डाप् प्रत्यय.

6.1.67.e: The हल् letter that belongs to a सम्बुद्धिप्रत्यय attached to एङन्त or ह्रस्वान्त word is removed.

6.1.68.e: In वेदाः, 'शि' is seen removed at some places.

6.1.69.e: A ह्रस्व letter that is followed by a कृत्-प्रत्यय that is पित् gets a तुगागम.

6.1.70.e: This is an अधिकार that runs till <<पारस्करप्रभृतीनि च संज्ञायाम्>> [[6.1.157]]. Anything told in this अधिकार happens only in the context of संहिता.

6.1.71.e: A ह्रस्व स्वर gets a तुक्-आगमः when followed by a छकार, in the context of संहिता.

6.1.72.e: The words आङ् and माङ् get a तुक्-आगम when followed by a छकार, in the context of संहिता.

6.1.73.a: दीर्घात् पदान्तात् संहितायाम् छे वा तुगागमः
6.1.73.e: A दीर्घ स्वर at end of a पद gets optional तुक्-आगमः when followed by a छकार,  in the context of संहिता.

6.1.74.e: An इक् letter which is followed by a स्वर is converted to a corresponding यण् letter in the context of संहिता.

6.1.75.e: When followed by a स्वर, the letters of the एच् प्रत्याहार are respectively converted to अय्, अव्, आय् and आव् in the context of संहिता.

6.1.76.e: An ओकार and an औकार are respectively converted to अव् and आव् when followed by a यकारादि प्रत्यय, in the context of संहिता.

6.1.77.a: धातोः यि-प्रत्यये तन्निमितस्यैव एचः वान्तः संहितायाम्
6.1.77.e: In the context of संहिता, the ओकार/औकार at the end of a धातु, when followed by यकारादि-प्रत्यय, is converted to अव् / आव्  only if that ओकार/औकार is generated by that यकारादिप्रत्यय itself.

6.1.78.e: The words क्षय्य and जय्य are considered to be derived, in the meaning of (respectively) 'the one that is capable of being destroyed' and 'the one that is capable of being won over'.

6.1.79.e: The words क्रय्य is considered to be derived, in the meaning of 'the one that can be purchased'.

6.1.80.e: In the context of Vedas, the words भय्य (the one from which somebody is afraid) and the word प्रवय्या (= a female being impregnated) are seen used (and should thus be considered derived).

6.1.81.e: This is an अधिकार that runs till <<ऋतः उत्>> [[6.1.111]]. Any आदेश told in this अधिकार should be understood as combined आदेश done on the participating entities.

6.1.82.e: The एकादेश told in the एकः पूर्वपरयोः अधिकार acts like the last letter of the पूर्वशब्द as well as the first letter of the परशब्द.

6.1.83.e: The एकादेश mentioned under the एकः पूर्वपरयोः अधिकार should be considered असिद्ध while doing षत्वम् or a तुक् आगम.

6.1.84.e: When an अवर्ण is followed by an अच् letter in the context of संहिता, both of them are replaced by a single गुण letter

6.1.85.e: When an अवर्ण is followed by an एच् letter in the context of संहिता, both of them are replaced by a single वृद्धि letter.

6.1.86.a: आत् एचि एति-एधति-ऊठ्सु एकः पूर्वपरयोः वृद्धिः
6.1.86.e: In the context of संहिता, When an अवर्ण followed by the एच् letter of the इण् धातु or एध् धातु, or the word ऊठ् ; both of them are replaced by a single वृद्धि letter.

6.1.87.e: When the आट्-आगम is followed by a अच्-letter,  both of them are replaced by a single वृद्धि letter.

6.1.88.a: आत् उपसर्गात् ऋति धातौ पूर्वपरयोः एकः वृद्धिः
6.1.88.e: When an अवर्णान्त उपसर्ग is followed by a  ऋकारादि verb form,  both of them are replaced by a single वृद्धि letter.

6.1.89.a: आत् उपसर्गात् ऋति सुपि धातौ पूर्वपरयोः वृद्धि-एकादेशः वा ।
6.1.89.e: When an अवर्णान्त उपसर्ग is followed by a ऋकारादि सुब्धातु, both of them are optionally replaced by a single वृद्धि letter.

6.1.90.a: ओतः अम्-शसोः अचि एकः पूर्वपरयोः आ
6.1.90.e: When an ओकार  is followed by the अम्-प्रत्यय or the शस्-प्रत्यय,  both the letters are replaced by single आकार.

6.1.91.a: आत् उपसर्गात् एङि धातौ पूर्वपरयोः एकः पररूपम्
6.1.91.e: When an अवर्णान्त उपसर्ग is followed by a एकारादि or ओकारादि verb form, both the letters are replaced by a single पररूप.

6.1.92.e: In the context of संहिता, When अवर्ण is followed by the word ओम् or the word आङ् , both the letters are replaced by a single पररूप.

6.1.93.a: अपदान्तात् आत् उसि पूर्वपरयोः एकः पररूपम्
6.1.93.e: In the context of संहिता, ऌhen a अवर्ण not occurring at end of a पद is followed by the word 'उस्', both of them are replaced by a single पररूप.

6.1.94.a: अपदान्तात् अतः गुणे पूर्वपरयोः एकः पररूपम्
6.1.94.e: In the context of संहिता, when an अपदान्त अकार is followed by a गुण letter, both of them are replaced by a single पररूप.

6.1.95.a: अव्यक्तानुकरणस्य अतः इतौ पूर्वपरयोः एकः पररूपम्
6.1.95.e: In the context of संहिता, When a word which is used to imitate some abstract sound and which ends is the phrase 'अत्' is followed by the word 'इति', then the 'अत्' of the previous word and the इ of इति are combined to form a पररूप-एकादेश.

6.1.96.a: आम्रेडितस्य अव्यक्तानुकरणस्य अन्त्यस्य अतः इतौ पूर्वपरयोः एकः पररूपम् तु वा
6.1.96.e: When a word which is used to imitate some abstract sound and which ends is the phrase 'अत्' and which is also an आम्रेडितसंज्ञक is followed by the word 'इति', then the 'अत्' of the previous word and the इ of इति are not combined as mentioned in the previous rule 'अव्यक्तानुकरणस्यात इतौ'. Instead, the त् and इ optionally combine to form a पररूप-एकादेश.

6.1.97.a: अकः सवर्णे अचि पूर्वपरयोः एकः दीर्घः
6.1.97.e: In the context of संहिता, when an अक् letter is followed by a सवर्ण अच् letter, both of them are replaced by a दीर्घ-एकादेश.

6.1.98.a: अकः प्रथमयोः अचि पूर्वपरयोः एकः पूर्वसवर्णः दीर्घः
6.1.98.e: When a letter from the  अक् प्रत्याहार is followed by an अजादि प्रत्यय of  प्रथमा or द्वितीया विभक्ति, then पूर्व and the पर letters are replaced by a single पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घ.

6.1.99.a: प्रथमयोः पूर्वसवर्णः तस्मात् पुँसि शसः नः
6.1.99.e: When the rule 'प्रथमयोः पूर्वसवर्णः' is used to create a पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घ for a पुंलिङ्ग word in presence of the शस्-प्रत्यय, then the सकार of the शस्-प्रत्यय is converted to नकार.

6.1.100.e: When अकार / आकार is followed by a प्रत्यय of प्रथमा or द्वितीया विभक्ति that begins with a letter of इच्-प्रत्याहार, then the पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घ given by 'प्रथमयोः पूर्वसवर्णः' does not happen.

6.1.101.a: दीर्घात् इचि जसि च प्रथमयोः पूर्वसवर्णः न ।
6.1.101.e: When दीर्घस्वर is followed by either the जस्-प्रत्यय, or a प्रत्यय of प्रथमा or द्वितीया विभक्ति that begins with a letter of इच्-प्रत्याहार, then the पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घ mandated by 'प्रथमयोः पूर्वसवर्णः' does not happen.

6.1.102.a: छन्दसि - दीर्घात् जसि इचि प्रथमयोः पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घः वा
6.1.102.e: The पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घनिषेध given by the sutra 'दीर्घाज्जसि च' is optional while deriving the Vedic forms.

6.1.103.a: अकः अमि पूर्वपरयोः एकः पूर्वः संहितायाम्
6.1.103.e: When a letter from the अक् प्रत्याहार is followed अकार of the अम्-प्रत्यय, both the letters are combined to form a पूर्वरूप-एकादेश.

6.1.104.e: When a letter having the sanjna सम्प्रसारण is followed by an अच् letter, both of them are combined to form a पूर्वरूप-एकादेश.

6.1.105.e: If a पदान्त ए / ओ letter is followed by a ह्रस्व अकार, then both of them combine to form a पूर्वरूप एकादेश.

6.1.106.a: एङः ङसिङसोः अति पूर्वपरयोः एकः पूर्वः
6.1.106.e: If an एकार or ओकार is followed by the अकार of ङसिँ or ङस् प्रत्यय,  then both of them combined to form a पूर्वरूप एकादेश.

6.1.107.a: ऋतः ङसिङसोः अति पूर्वपरयोः एकः उत्
6.1.107.e: If a ऋकार or ऌकार is followed by the अकार of  ङसिँ or ङस् प्रत्यय,  then both of them combined to form an उकार.

6.1.108.e: The अकार of the  ङसिँ/ङस् प्रत्यय following a 'ख्य्' / 'त्य्' is converted to उकार.

6.1.109.a: अप्लुतात् अतः रोः उत् अप्लुते अति
6.1.109.e: A रुँ letter that is sandwiched between an अप्लुत-ह्रस्व-अकार from each side is converted to an उकार.

6.1.110.e: A रुँ letter that follows an अप्लुत-ह्रस्व-अकार and is followed by a हश् letter is converted to an उकार.

6.1.111.e: The final ए or ओ and the following अ when occurring in the middle half of a foot of a Vedic verse, retain their original forms, except when the अ is followed by ख् or य्।

6.1.112.e: The ए or ओ retain their original form in the middle of a Vedic verse, when the following words come after them (though the अ in these has a व् and य् following it) - अव्यात् , अवद्यात् , अवक्रमुः , अव्रत , अवन्तु , अवस्यु।

6.1.113.e: In the यजुर्वेद , the word उरस् when changed to उरो , retains it original form when followed by a short अ which is also retained.

6.1.114.e: In the यजुर्वेद , the short अ is retained after आपो , जुषाणो , वृष्णो , वर्षिष्ठे and also in and after अम्बे or अम्बाले when they stand before अम्बिके।

6.1.115.e: In the यजुर्वेद , when the word अङ्गे is followed by अङ्गे , the subsequent short अ is retained, as well as the preceding ए or ओ।

6.1.116.e: In the यजुर्वेद , when an अनुदात्त अ is followed by a Guttural or a ध, the antecedent ए or ओ retains it s form, as well as this subsequent अ।

6.1.117.e: In the यजुर्वेद , when the gravely accented अ of अवपथास् follows ए or ओ , the vowels retain their original form.

6.1.118.a: पदान्तात् गोः एङः अति सर्वत्र प्रकृत्या विभाषा
6.1.118.e: In the context of संहिता, an ओकार occurring at the end of the पदसंज्ञक गो शब्द exhibits optional प्रकृतिभाव when followed by a ह्रस्व अकार.

6.1.119.a: पदान्तात् गोः अचि अवङ् विभाषा स्फोटायनस्य
6.1.119.e: In the context of संहिता, The पदसंज्ञक गो word when followed by a स्वर gets an अवङ् आदेश optionally.

6.1.120.e: In the context of संहिता, The word गो when followed by the word इन्द्र gets the अवङ्-आदेश.

6.1.121.e: प्लुत letters and प्रगृह्य words do not undergo a सन्धि when followed by an अच्-letter, even when there is संहिता.

6.1.122.e: In the context of संहिता and in the derivation of the वैदिक forms, when आङ् is followed by an अच् letter, आङ् becomes अनुनासिक and does not undergo sandhi with the अच् letter.

6.1.123.a: इकः पदान्तात् असवर्णे अचि प्रकृत्या ह्रस्वः च
6.1.123.e: According to शाकल्य, In the context of संहिता a पदान्त-इक्-letter, when followed by an असवर्ण अच्-letter undergoes ह्रस्वादेशः and then no other sandhi happens.

6.1.124.a: पदान्तस्य  अकः असवर्णे ऋति ह्रस्वः  प्रकृत्या शाकल्यस्य
6.1.124.e: According to शाकल्य, In the context of संहिता a पदान्त-अक्-letter, when followed by a ह्रस्व ऋ/ऌ-letter undergoes ह्रस्वादेशः and then no other sandhi happens.

6.1.125.e: When followed by an अवैदिक 'इति' word, a प्लुत behaves as if it is not प्लुत in the context of संहिता.

6.1.126.e: According to चाक्रवर्मण, the प्लुतः ईकारः behaves as if it is not प्लुत when followed by an अच्-letter in the context of संहिता.

6.1.127.e: The 'दिव्' word that is a पद also gets the उत्-आदेश.

6.1.128.e: Except for the नञ् समास, when a form of एतद्/तद् word which does not contain a ककार is followed by a  सुँ-प्रत्यय which in turn is followed by a व्यञ्जन. the सुँ-प्रत्यय gets removed in the context of संहिता.

6.1.129.e: In the derivation of the Vedic words, the सुँ-प्रत्यय attached to the प्रथमा-एकवचन of the word त्यद् might or might not be removed when followed by a हल् in the context of संहिता.

6.1.130.a: लोपे पादपूरणम् चेत् - सः अचि लोपः
6.1.130.e: The सुँ-प्रत्यय of सः gets removed when followed by an अच्, provided that (only) by doing so, the पाद can be completed.

6.1.131.e: The augment सुट् is placed before क even when the augment अट् [[6.4.71]] or the Reduplicate intervenes (between the preposition and the verb).

6.1.132.e: The augment सुट् is placed before क when सम् , परि , and उप are followed by the verb कृ and the sense is that of ornamenting.

6.1.133.e: The augment सुट् is placed before क even when सम् , परि , and उप are followed by the verb कृ and the sense being that of combining.

6.1.134.e: The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after उप , and the sense is that of 'to take pains for something, to prepare, and to supply and ellipses in a discourse'.

6.1.135.e: The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after उप , and the sense is that of 'to cut or to split'.

6.1.136.e: The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after उप and प्रति and the sense 'to cause suffering'.

6.1.137.e: The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after अप and the sense is 'the scraping of earth by four-footed animals or birds'.

6.1.138.e: The word कुस्तुम्बुरु is irregularly, formed with the augment सुट् and means 'a species of herb'.

6.1.139.e: The word अपस्पराः is formed by the augment सुट् when the sense is that of 'uninterrupted action'.

6.1.140.e: The word गोष्पद is formed by सुट् , when meaning a locality visited or not visited by cows, or when it means quantity.

6.1.141.e: The word आस्पद is formed by सुट् when meaning 'a place or position'.

6.1.142.e: The word आशचर्य is formed by सुट् when meaning something 'unusual'.

6.1.143.e: The word अवस्कर is formed by सुट् meaning 'excrement'.

6.1.144.e: The word अपस्कर is formed by सुट् meaning 'the part of a chariot'.

6.1.145.e: The word विषिकर is formed with सुट् optionally when denoting a kind of bird, the other form being विकार।

6.1.146.e: In a मन्त्र , the सुट् is added to चन्द्र when it is second member in a compound and is preceded by a short vowel.

6.1.147.e: To the root कश् 'to go, to punish', is added the augment सुट् , when preceded by the preposition प्रति , the form being प्रतिष्कशः।

6.1.148.e: The words प्रस्कण्व and हरिश्चन्द्र are formed by सुट् meaning the two Rishis of that name.

6.1.149.e: The word मस्कर means 'a bamboo', and मस्करिन् means 'a medicant monk'.

6.1.150.e: The words कास्तर and अजस्तुन्द are names of cities.

6.1.151.e: The words पारस्कर etc. are Names.

6.1.152.e: A word is, with the exception of one syllable, unaccented.

6.1.153.e: A stem formed with the कृत-affix घञ् has the acute accent on the end-syllable, if it is formed from the root कृष् (कर्षति) or has a long आ in it.

6.1.154.e: The words उच्छ etc. have acute accent on the last syllable.

6.1.155.e: An unaccented vowel gets also the acute accent, when on account of it preceding acute is elided.

6.1.156.e: A root has the acute on the end syllable.

6.1.157.e: The word ending in चित्-प्रत्यय becomes अन्तोदात्त.

6.1.158.e: The word ending in a तद्धितसंज्ञक चित्-प्रत्यय become अन्तोदात्त.

6.1.159.e: The word ending in a तद्धितसंज्ञक कित्-प्रत्यय become अन्तोदात्त.

6.1.160.e: The Nominative Plural (जस्) of तिस् has acute accent on the last syllable.

6.1.161.e: The word चतुर् , followed by the Accusative Plural, has acute accent on the last syllable.

6.1.162.e: The case affixes of the Instrumental and of the cases that follow it have the acute accent, if the stem in the Locative Plural is monosyllabic.

6.1.163.e: The same case endings may optionally have the acute accent, if the monosyllabic word stands at the end of a compound, and has acute accent on the final, when the compound can be easily unloosened.

6.1.164.e: In the छन्दस् , the case-endings other than the सर्वनामस्थान , get the acute accent when coming after अञ्चि।

6.1.165.e: The same (असर्वनामस्थान) case-endings have the acute accent, when the stem ends in वाह् , also after इदम् after पद् etc. (up to [[6.1.63]]) after अप , पुंस् , रै and दिव्।

6.1.166.e: The असर्वनामस्थान case-endings after अष्टन् 'eight', have acute accent, when it gets the form अष्टा।

6.1.167.e: After an oxytone Particle in अत् the feminine suffix ई , (नदि) and the case endings beginning with vowels (with the exception of strong cases) have acute accent, when the participial affix has not the augment न् (i.e. is not अन्त).

6.1.168.e: The same endings have the acute accent, when for the acutely accented final vowel of the stem, a semi-vowel is substituted, and which is preceded by a consonant.

6.1.169.e: But not so, when the vowel is of the feminine affix ऊ [[4.1.66]], or the final of a root.

6.1.170.e: The otherwise unaccented मत् (वत्) takes the acute accent, when an oxytoned stem ends in a light vowel, or the affix has before it the augment न् [[8.2.16]].

6.1.171.e: After an oxytoned stem which ends in a light vowel, the genitive ending नाम् has optionally the acute accent.

6.1.172.e: In the छन्दस , the ending नाम् has diversely the acute accent after the feminine affix ई।

6.1.173.e: The case-endings beginning with a consonant, have the acute accent after the Numerals called षट् [[1.1.24]], as well as after त्रि and चतुर् ।

6.1.174.e: The above numerals, when taking a case-affix beginning with a भस् or स् , get the acute accent on the penultimate syllable, when the said numerals assume a form consisting of three or more syllables.

6.1.175.e: In the Secular language this is optional.

6.1.176.e: The foregoing rules from [[6.1.168]] downwards have no applicability after गो , and श्वन् and words ending in them; nor after a stem which before the case ending of the Nominative Singular has अ or आ , nor after रज् , or after a stem ending in अञ्च् , nor as well as after कुञ्च् and कृत्।

6.1.177.e: After दिव् a case-ending beginning with भ or स is unaccented.

6.1.178.e: After नृ , a case-ending beginning with भ or स is optionally unaccented.

6.1.179.e: The first स्वर of a तित् प्रत्यय becomes स्वरित.

6.1.180.e: The Personal-endings and their substitutes [[3.2.124]]-126 are, when they are सार्वधातुक [[3.4.113]] etc., unaccented after the characteristic of the Periphrastic Future (तासि) after a root which in the धातुपाठ has an unaccented vowel or a ङ् (with the exception of ह्नुङ् and इङ्) as indicatory letter, as well as after what has a final अ in the Grammatical System of Instruction (उपदेश)।

6.1.181.e: The सिच् Aorist, the first syllable may optionally have the acute accent.

6.1.182.e: The acute accent is optionally on the first syllable when a Personal-ending, being सार्वधातुक tense affix beginning with a vowel, provided that the vowel is not the augment इट् , follows after स्वप् etc., or after हिंस्।

6.1.183.e: The acute accent falls on the first syllable of the reduplicate verbs when followed by an affix beginning with a vowel (the vowel being not नुट्) and being a सार्वधातुक Personal-ending.

6.1.184.e: Also when the unaccented endings of the three persons in the singular follow, the first syllable of the reduplicate has the acute.

6.1.185.e: The acute is on the first syllable of सर्व when the case-endings follow.

6.1.186.e: In भी , ह्री , भृ , हु , मद् , जन् , धन् , दरिद्रा and जागृ , and in their reduplicates, the acute accent is, before the सार्वधातुक unaccented endings of the three persons in singular, (पित्), on the syllable which precedes the affix.

6.1.187.e: For the प्रकृति-प्रत्यय-समुदाय that ends in a लित्-प्रत्यय, the स्वर that comes before the प्रत्यय becomes उदात्त.

6.1.188.e: The first syllable may be optionally acute when the absolutive affix णमुल् follows.

6.1.189.e: The roots which are exhibited in धातुपाठ with a final vowel, may be optionally have the acute on the first syllable, before the affixes of the Passive (यक्), when the sense of the verb is Reflexive.

6.1.190.e: Before the ending थ of the Perfect, Second Person Singular, when this ending takes the augment इ ; the acute accent falls either on the first syllable, or on this इ , or on the personal ending.

6.1.191.e: The word ending in a ञित् or a नित् प्रत्यय become आद्युदात्त.

6.1.192.e: The first syllable of a Vocative gets the acute accent.

6.1.193.e: The acute accent is on the first syllable of पथिन् and मथिन् when followed by a strong case-ending.

6.1.194.e: The Infinitive in तवै has the acute on the first syllable and on the last syllable at one and the same time.

6.1.195.e: The word क्षय has the acute on the first syllable and on the last syllable at one and the same time.

6.1.196.e: The acute accent falls on the first syllable of जय , in the sense of 'whereby one attains victory'.

6.1.197.e: The words वृष etc. have the acute on the first syllable.

6.1.198.e: The acute accent falls on the first syllable of that word with which something is likened, provided that it is a name.

6.1.199.e: A disyllabic Participle in त (निष्ठा) when a Name has the acute on the first syllable, but not if the first syllable has an आ।

6.1.200.e: Also शुष्क and धृष्ट have acute on the first syllable.

6.1.201.e: The word आशित meaning 'having eaten' has acute on the first syllable.

6.1.202.e: The word रिक्त may have optionally the acute on the first syllable.

6.1.203.e: In the छन्दस , the words जुष्ट and अर्पित have optionally the acute on the first syllable.

6.1.204.e: In the मन्त्राः , these words जुष्ट and अर्पित have always the acute on the first syllable.

6.1.205.e: The acute accent is on the first syllable of युष्मद् and अस्मद् in the Genitive Singular.

6.1.206.e: The acute accent is on the first syllable of युष्मद् and अस्मद् in the Dative Singular.

6.1.207.e: Whatever is formed by the affix यत् , has, if it is a disyllabic word, the acute on the first syllable, with the exception of नाव्यः from नौ।

6.1.208.e: The acute accent is on the first syllable of ईड् , वन्द , वृ , शंस् and दुह् , when they are followed by the affix ण्यत्।

6.1.209.e: The acute accent is optionally on the first syllable of वेणु and इन्धान।

6.1.210.e: The acute accent is optionally on the first syllables of त्याग , राग , हास , कुह , श्वठ , and क्रथ।

6.1.211.e: The second last  स्वर of the प्रकृति-प्रत्यय-समुदाय that ends in a रित् प्रत्यय becomes उदात्त.

6.2.1.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the first member preserves its own original accent.

6.2.2.e: In a तत्-पुरुष समास the first member preserves its original accent when it is a word - 1. meaning 'a resemblance' or 2. an Instrumental or 3. a Locative or 4. a word with which the second member is compared or 5. an indeclinable or 6. an Accusative or 7. a Future Passive Participle

6.2.3.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when a word denoting colour is compounded with another colour denoting word but not so when it is the word एत।

6.2.4.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second term is गाध or लवण and the compound expresses 'a measure or mass'.

6.2.5.e: In a तत्-पुरुष समास having the word दायद् as its second member, the first member denoting inheritance preserves its original accent.

6.2.6.e: In a तत्-पुरुष समास having the words चिर or कृच्छ्र as its second member, the first member, when it denotes that which experiences an obstacle, preserves its original accent.

6.2.7.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word पद denoting 'a pretext'.

6.2.8.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word निवात in the sense of 'a protection from wind'.

6.2.9.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word शारद having any other sense than that of 'autumnal'.

6.2.10.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word अध्वर्यु or कषाय denoting a genus.

6.2.11.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word सदृश or प्रतिरूप expressing resemblance with someone or something.

6.2.12.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) denoting 'measure or quantity'.

6.2.13.e: Before the word वाणिज 'a trader' the first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its accent when it is a word specifying the place wither one has to go or the ware in which one deals.

6.2.14.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the words 1. मात्रा 2. उपज्ञा 3. उपक्रम and 4. छाया when these words appear as neuter.

6.2.15.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when its second term is सुख or प्रिय and the sense is 'to feel delight' or 'is good'.

6.2.16.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when its second term is सुख or प्रिय and the sense is 'agreeable to one' or 'desired'.

6.2.17.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when it denotes a thing possessed and when its second term is स्वामिन्।

6.2.18.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when it ends in पति and means 'master' or 'lord'.

6.2.19.e: The words भू , वाक् , चित् and दिधिषू however do not preserve their original accent in तत्-पुरुष समास when coming before the word पति denoting 'master' or 'lord'.

6.2.20.e: The word भुवन may optionally keep its accent in a तत्-पुरुष समास before the word पति denoting 'master' or 'lord'.

6.2.21.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent before words आशङ्क , आबाध and नेदीयस् , when it treats about a supposition.

6.2.22.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word पूर्व and the sense is 'this had been lately…'.

6.2.23.e: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is 1. सविध 2. सनीड 3. समर्याद 4. सवेश and 5. सदेश in the sense of 'what can be found in the vicinity thereof'.

6.2.24.e: The words विस्पष्ट etc. preserve their accent when followed by an adjective word in a compound.

6.2.25.e: In a कर्मधारय समास the first member consisting of a भाव (verbal noun) preserves its original accent before the adjective forms built from श्र -- प्रशस्यस्य श्रः [[5.3.60]], ज्य -- ज्य च [[5.3.61]], अवम and कन् -- युवाल्पयोः कनन्यतरस्याम् [[5.3.64]], and before a form built from the word पाप।

6.2.26.e: In a कर्मधारय समास the first member consisting of the word कुमार preserves it original accent.

6.2.27.e: In a कर्मधारय समास of कुमार followed by प्रत्येनस् the acutely accented (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of कुमार।

6.2.28.e: The first syllable of कुमार is optionally acutely accented (उदात्त) when the second member is a word denoting 'the name of a horde'.

6.2.29.e: In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the first member preserves its original accent before a stem ending in a simple vowel with the exception of अ (इक्) before a word denoting time, as well as before 1. कपाल 2. भगाल and 3. शराव।

6.2.30.e: In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the word बहु may optionally preserve its accent when followed by an इक्-ending stem or by a time-word or by 1. कपाल 2. भगाल and 3. शराव।

6.2.31.e: In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the first member may optionally preserve its accent when followed by the words दिष्टि and वितस्ति।as its second members.

6.2.32.e: When a word ending in the Locative -7th case does not denote time preserves its original accent when followed by 1. सिद्ध 2. शुष्क 3. पक्व and 4. बन्ध in a compound.

6.2.33.e: The particles 1. परि 2. प्रति 3. उप and 4. अप preserve their accent before that word which specifies an exclusion or a portion of day and night (in an अव्ययीभाव समास also).

6.2.34.e: The first member of a द्वन्द समास formed of names denoting the क्षत्रिय (warrior) clans in the plural number retains its original accent when the warrior belongs to the clan of अन्धक or वृष्णि।

6.2.35.e: The numeral word standing as the first member of a द्वन्द समास , preserves its accent.

6.2.36.e: When words denoting scholars are named after their teachers and are compounded into a द्वन्द समास the first member retains its accent.

6.2.37.e: Also in the द्वन्द समास-s कार्तकौजप etc. the first members retain their accent.

6.2.38.e: The word महत् (महा) retains its accent before the following - 1. व्रीहि 2. अपराह्ण 3. गृष्टि 4. इष्वास 5. जाबाल 6. भार 7. भारत 8. हैलिहिल 9. रौरव and 10. प्रवृद्धे।

6.2.39.e: The words महत् and क्षुल्लक retain their accent before the word वैश्वदेव।

6.2.40.e: The word उष्ट्र retains its accent before सादि and वामि।

6.2.41.e: The word गो retains its accent before 1. साद 2. सादि and 3. सारथि।

6.2.42.e: The first member retains its accent in the following - 1. कुरु-गार्हपत 2. रिक्त-गुरु 3. असूत-जरती 4. अश्लील-दृढ-रूपा 5. पारे-वडवा 6. तैतिल-कद्रूः 7. पण्य-कम्बलः and 8. दासीभार etc.

6.2.43.e: A word in the Dative -4th Case as the first member retains its accent when the second member expresses that which is suited to become the former.

6.2.44.e: Before the word अर्थ the first member in the Dative -4th Case retains its accent.

6.2.45.e: The first member in the Dative -4th Case retains its accent before a Past Participle in क्त।

6.2.46.e: Before the Past Participle in क्त the first member when it itself is not a Past Participle, retains its original accent in a कर्मधारय समास ।

6.2.47.e: Before the Past Participle in क्त , a word ending in the Accusative -2nd case retains its accent when it does not mean a separation.

6.2.48.e: A word ending in the Instrumental -3rd case retains its accent before the Past Participle in क्त when it has a Passive meaning.

6.2.49.e: A word called गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], when standing immediately before a Participle in क्त having a Passive significance, retains its accent.

6.2.50.e: An immediately preceding गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], retains its original accent before (a word formed by) a कृत्-affix beginning with त् which as an indicatory न् but before तु।

6.2.51.e: An immediately preceding गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], retains its original accent before an Infinitive in तवै -- कृत्यार्थे तवैकेन्केन्यत्वनः [[3.4.14]], but whereby simultaneously the final has the acute as well.

6.2.52.e: An immediately preceding गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], not ending in इ or उ retains its accent before an affix having a व् follows.

6.2.53.e: The गति-s नि and अधि however retain their original accent before अञ्च् when the affix व् follows.

6.2.54.e: The word ईषत् when the first member of a compound may optionally preserve its original accent.

6.2.55.e: The first member denoting the quantity of gold retains optionally its original accent before the word धन।

6.2.56.e: The word प्रथम when first in a compound optionally retains its original accent when meaning 'a novice'.

6.2.57.e: The words कतर and कतम when as first member of a compound optionally retain their original accent in a कर्मधारय समास।

6.2.58.e: The word आर्य optionally retains its original accent in a कर्मधारय समास before the words ब्राह्मण and कुमार।

6.2.59.e: The word राजन् optionally retains its original accent in a कर्मधारय समास before the words ब्राह्मण and कुमार।

6.2.60.e: The word राजन् ending in Genitive 6th-Case optionally retains its original accent before the word प्रत्येनस्।

6.2.61.e: A word having the sense of 'always' optionally retains its original accent before a Past Participle in क्त ।

6.2.62.e: The word ग्राम when first member of a compound optionally retains its original accent before a word denoting 'a professional man or artisan'.

6.2.63.e: The word राजन् optionally retains its original accent after a profession-denoting noun when praise is expressed.

6.2.64.e: In the following up to -- न भूताधिकसंजीवमद्राश्मकज्जलम् [[6.2.91]], inclusive, the phrase 'the first syllable in -(the word standing in the Nominative 1st-Case) has the acute accent (उदात्त)' is always to be supplied.

6.2.65.e: If the first member of a compound is in the Locative -7th case or denoting the name of the Receiver of Tax, has acutely accented (उदात्त) first syllable, when the second member is a word denoting 'what is lawful', but not when it is हरण।

6.2.66.e: The first member of a compound has acute on the first syllable when the second member denotes that by whom the things denoted by the first are regulated or kept in order.

6.2.67.e: The acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable is optional when the word अध्यक्ष follows.

6.2.68.e: The word पाप is optionally acutely accented (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by a word denoting a professional man.

6.2.69.e: The first syllable of the first member of a compound is acutely accented (उदात्त) before a गोत्र (Patronymic) name or a Scholar-name and also before माणव and ब्राह्मण when a reproach is meant.

6.2.70.e: The first syllable of the word preceding मैरेय gets the acute accent (उदात्त) when it denotes the ingredient of the same.

6.2.71.e: A word denoting food gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when before a word which denotes a repository suited to contain that.

6.2.72.e: A word denoting the object of comparison gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when standing before गो , बिडाल , सिंह and सैन्धव।

6.2.73.e: A word denoting the object of comparison gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when the second member is a word ending in the affix अक and the compound expresses a calling by which one gets his living.

6.2.74.e: A compound, the second member of which is a word ending in affix अक and which denotes the sport of the Eastern people, gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.75.e: A compound, the second member of which is a word ending in the कृत् -affix अण् and which denotes a functionary, gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.76.e: And when such a compound ending in अण् -affix denotes the name of a professional man, but not when the second term कार(derived from कृञ्), the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the first syllable of the first word.

6.2.77.e: Also when such an उपपद compound ending in अण् -affix denotes a Name, the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable but not when the second term is कार।

6.2.78.e: The words 1. गो 2. तन्ति and 3. यव get the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by पाल।

6.2.79.e: A compound ending in कृत् -affix णिनि (इन्) has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable of the first member.

6.2.80.e: When the first member of a compound expresses that with which resemblance is denoted then it has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable before a word formed by णिनि (इन्) affix, only then, when such latter word is radical without any preposition and means 'giving out a definite sound like so and so'.

6.2.81.e: The compounds युक्तारोहिन् etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.82.e: When the first member is a word ending in a long vowel or is 1. काश 2. तुष 3. भ्राष्ट्र 4. वट and is followed by ज , the acutely accented (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable.

6.2.83.e: In a word consisting of more than two syllables followed by ज , the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the syllable before the last.

6.2.84.e: Before ग्राम the first syllable of the first member as acute accent (उदात्त) when thereby inhabitants are not meant.

6.2.85.e: The first member has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by घोषा etc.

6.2.86.e: The words छात्रि etc. get acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by the word शाला।

6.2.87.e: The first member which has not a वृद्धि in the first syllable or which is not कर्की etc. gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable before प्रस्थ।

6.2.88.e: The first syllable of माला etc. gets the acute accent (उदात्त) when प्रस्थ follows.

6.2.89.e: The first member has an acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable before the word नगर but not when it is the word महत् or नव , nor when it refers to a city in the lands of the Northern People.

6.2.90.e: A word of two or three syllables ending in a अ or आ (with the exception of महा and नव) standing before the word अर्म has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.91.e: The following words do not get acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when standing before अर्म etc. - 1. भूत 2. अधिक 3. संजीव 4. मद्र 5. अश्मन् and 6. कञ्जल।

6.2.92.e: In the following sūtras up to निष्ठोपसर्गपूर्वमन्यतरस्याम् [[6.2.110]], inclusive, is to be supplied the phrase 'the last syllable in a word standing in the Nominative 1st-Case has the acute accent (उदात्त)'.

6.2.93.e: The acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final of the word सर्व standing as the first member before an attributive word in the sense 'whole, through and through'.

6.2.94.e: The last syllable of the first member before गिरि and निकाय has the acute accent (उदात्त) when the compound is a Name.

6.2.95.e: The last syllable of the first member get the acute accent (उदात्त) when the word कुमारी follows, the compound denoting age.

6.2.96.e: Before the word उदक when the compound denotes a mixture, the last syllable of the first member has the acute accent (उदात्त).

6.2.97.e: Before a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound), when the compound denotes a sacrifice, the last syllable of the first member has the acute accent (उदात्त).

6.2.98.e: Before the word सभा when it is exhibited as Neuter, the first member of the compound gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.

6.2.99.e: Before the word पुर , when the compound denotes a city of the Eastern People, the final of the final of the first member as the acute accent (उदात्त).

6.2.100.e: When the words अरिष्ट and गौड stand first, the first member has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final before the word पुर।

6.2.101.e: But when the words 1. हास्तिन 2. फलक and 3. मार्देय precede पुर , the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on their final.

6.2.102.e: The words 1. कुसूल 2. कूप 3. कुम्भ and 4. शाला have the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable before the word बिल।

6.2.103.e: Words expressing (in space of time) have acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable when followed by a word denoting a village or a country or a narrative before the word चानराट।

6.2.104.e: The direction denoting words have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final, before the names of scholars when such names derived from those of their teachers.

6.2.105.e: Words denoting direction and the word सर्व have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final before a word which takes वृद्धि in the first syllable of the second term by सुसर्वार्धाज्जनपदस्य [[7.3.12]].

6.2.106.e: The word विश्व has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final, being first member in a बहुव्रीहि समास , when it is a Name.

6.2.107.e: The first member in a बहुव्रीहि समास , before the words 1. उदर 2. अश्व and 3. इषु , gets acute accent (उदात्त) on the final syllable when the compound denotes a Name.

6.2.108.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास having the word बन्धु as its second member, the first member ending in the feminine affix ई (नदी word) has the ac on its final syllable.

6.2.109.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास a Participle in a क्त preceded by a preposition, standing as the first member of the compound has optionally acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.

6.2.110.e: In the following sūtras up to कुण्डं वनम् [[6.2.136]], inclusive, should always be supplied the phrase 'the first syllable of the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त)'.

6.2.111.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the word कर्ण standing as second member has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when it is preceded by a word denoting colour or mark.

6.2.112.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the second member कर्ण has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when the compound denotes a Name or Resemblance.

6.2.113.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास expressing a Name or comparison the second members 1. कण्ठ 2. पृष्ठ 3. ग्रीवा and 4. जङ्घा have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.114.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास denoting age (as well as a Name or a Resemblance), the second member शृङ्ग gets acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.115.e: After a Negative Particle, in a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of 1. जर 2. मर 3. मित्र and 4. मृत।

6.2.116.e: After the adjective सु in a बहुव्रीहि समास a stem ending in मन् and अस् with the exception of लोमन् and उषस् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.117.e: After the adjective सु in a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of क्रतु etc.

6.2.118.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास in the छन्दस् (Vedas) a word of two syllables with acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when preceded by सु gets acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.119.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after सु the words वीर and वीर्य have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.120.e: In an अव्ययीभाव समास the following second terms have acute accent (उदात्त) on their first syllable - 1. कूल 2. तीर 3. तूल 4. मूल 5. शाला 6. अक्ष and 7. सम।

6.2.121.e: In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the following second members get acute accent (उदात्त) on their first syllable - 1. कंस 2. मन्थ 3. शूर्प 3. पाय्य and 4. काण्ड।

6.2.122.e: The word शाला at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास when exhibited in the Neuter has acute on the first syllable.

6.2.123.e: In a Neuter तत्-पुरुष समास ending in कन्था the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of the second member.

6.2.124.e: In a Neuter तत्-पुरुष समास ending in कन्था the first syllable of चिहण etc. have the acute accent (उदात्त).

6.2.125.e: The words 1. चेल 2. खेट 3. कटुक and 4. काण्ड at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when a reproach is meant.

6.2.126.e: The word चीर at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when something is compared with it.

6.2.127.e: In a तत्-पुरुष समास ending in 1. पलल 2. सूप and 3. शाक the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of these when the compound denotes a food mixed or seasoned with something.

6.2.128.e: The words 1. कूल 2. सूद 3. स्थल and 4. कर्ष have acute accent (उदात्त) on their first syllable when at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास denoting a Name.

6.2.129.e: The word राज्यम् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास which is not a कर्मधारय समास ।

6.2.130.e: At the end of a non-कर्मधारय तत्-पुरुष समास the words वर्ग्य etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.131.e: The word पुत्र coming after a Masculine noun in a तत्-पुरुष समास has a acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.132.e: The word पुत्र does not have an acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when preceded by a word which falls under the category of teachers, kings, priests, wife's relations and agnates and cognates.

6.2.133.e: The words चूर्ण etc. in a तत्-पुरुष समास have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when preceding word ends in a Genitive 6th-Case and does not denote a living being.

6.2.134.e: The six words - 1. काण्ड 2. चीर 3. पलल 4. सूप 5. शाक and 6. कूल of sūtras [[6.2.126]]-129 preceded by a non-living Genitive 6th-Case word have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.135.e: The word कुण्ड at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास denoting 'a wood or forest' has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.136.e: The word भगाल at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent.

6.2.137.e: After शिति , a word retains in a बहुव्रीहि समास its original accent when it is always of not more than two syllables with the exception of भसद्.।

6.2.138.e: In a तत्-पुरुष समास a word ending in a कृत् affix preserves its original accent when preceded by an indeclinable called गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], or a noun standing in intimate relation to a verb (कारक) or any word which gives occasion for compounding (उपपद -- तत्रोपपदं सप्तमीस्थम् [[3.1.92]])

6.2.139.e: In वनस्पति etc. both members of the compound preserve their original accent simultaneously.

6.2.140.e: In a द्वन्द compound of the Names of Divinities, both the members retain their original accent.

6.2.141.e: In a द्वन्द compound of the Names of Divinities, both members of the compound simultaneously do not retain their accent when the first syllable of the second word is अनुदात्त with the exception of 1.पृथिवी 2. रुद्र 3. पूष and 4. मन्थिन्।

6.2.142.e: In the following sūtras up to the end of this chapter should always be supplied the phrase 'the last syllable of the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त)'.

6.2.143.e: The last syllable of the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त) in the verbal nouns ending in 1. थ 2. अथ 3. घञ् 4. क्त 5. अच् 6. अप् 7. इत्र and 8. क when preceded by a गति , a कारक or an उपपद -- गतिकारकोपपदात् कृत् [[6.2.139]]

6.2.144.e: The Participle in क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when it is preceded by सु or by a word with which the second member is compared.

6.2.145.e: The Participle in क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable when preceded by a गति or a कारक or an उपपद if the compound denotes a Name, but not in आचित etc.

6.2.146.e: The word प्रवृद्ध etc. ending in क्त have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.147.e: The final of Part Participles दत्त and श्रुत alone have the acute accent (उदात्त) in a compound denoting a Name and a Benediction, the preceding word being a word standing in close relation to an action (कारक)।

6.2.148.e: The Participle in क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when the compound denotes 'done by one in such a condition'.

6.2.149.e: After a कारक as mentioned in कारकाद्दत्तश्रुतयोरेवाशिषि [[6.2.148]], the second member ending in the affix अन and denoting an action in the Abstract or the object (i.e. having the senses of Passive Adjective), has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.150.e: The words ending in मन् or क्तिन् affixes and the words 1. व्याख्यान 2. शयन 3. आसन 4. स्थान and 5. क्रीत as well as याजक etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when at the end of a compound preceded by कारक word.

6.2.151.e: The word पुण्य has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by a Noun in the Locative -7th case.

6.2.152.e: The acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the final of words having the sense of ऊन and of कलह when they are second members in a compound, preceded by a term in the Instrumental -3rd case.

6.2.153.e: The word मिश्र has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after an Instrumental -3rd case when it is not joined with any Preposition and does not mean a 'compact or alliance'.

6.2.154.e: The words formed with the तद्धित affixes denoting 'fitted for that' -- सम्पादिनि [[5.1.99]], 'deserving that' -- तद् अर्हति [[5.1.63]], 'good for that' -- तस्मै हितम् [[5.1.5]], 'capable to effect that' -- तस्मै प्रभवति संतापादिभ्यः [[5.1.101]], have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by the Negative Particle नञ् , when it makes a negation with regard to the above mentioned attributes.

6.2.155.e: The words formed with the तद्धित affixes य and यत् when not denoting 'useful for that' have acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable after the particle नञ् negating the attribute.

6.2.156.e: A word formed with the कृत् affixes अच् and क preceded by the particle नञ् has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when the meaning is 'not capable'.

6.2.157.e: A word formed by the कृत् affixes अच् and क preceded by a Negative Particle have an acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when one abuses somebody by that word.

6.2.158.e: When abuse is meant, a word preceded by नञ् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in denoting a Name.

6.2.159.e: After the Negative Particle, the words formed by the कृत्य affixes -- कृत्याः प्राङ् ण्वुलः [[3.1.95]], by उक and इष्णुच् and the words चारु etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.160.e: After the negative particle, the final of the following is optionally acute accent (उदात्त) - a word formed with the affix तृन् and the words 1. अन्न 2. तीक्ष्ण and 3. शुचि।

6.2.161.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after the words इदम् , एतद् and तद् the last syllable of प्रथम and of a proper ordinal numeral as the acute accent (उदात्त) when the number of times of an action is meant.

6.2.162.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after a numeral the word स्तन has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.163.e: Optionally so, in the छन्दस् (Vedas), the स्तन after a numeral has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.164.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in मित्र and अजिन the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the last syllable when the compound denotes a Name.

6.2.165.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in अन्तर the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final after a word which denotes 'that which lies between'.

6.2.166.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final when the second member is मुख 'mouth' i.e. the actual bodily part of an animal and not used metaphorically.

6.2.167.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on such मुख 'mouth' denoting a real mouth when it comes after an indeclinable and a name of a direction or after 1. गो 2. महत् 3. स्थूल 4. मुष्टि 5. पृथु and 6. वत्स।

6.2.168.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the word मुख denoting 'an actual mouth' has optionally the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by a participle in त or by that wherewith something is compared.

6.2.169.e: After a word denoting a species (with the exception of a word for 'garment or covering') and after a time-denoting word as well as after सुख etc. the Participle in the क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in a बहुव्रीहि समास but not so when the participles are 1. कृत 2. मित 3. प्रतिपन्न।

6.2.170.e: After a species (with the exception of a word for 'garment or covering') or a time-denoting word or after सुख etc. in a बहुव्रीहि समास the word जात has optionally acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.171.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास formed by the negative particle नञ् or by सु has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable of the compound.

6.2.172.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास formed by the negative particle नञ् or by सु and ending in the affix कप् -- नद्यृतश्च [[5.4.153]], has acute accent (उदात्त) on the syllable preceding the affix.

6.2.173.e: When the compound ends in a light vowel the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the syllable before such last, in a बहुव्रीहि समास preceded by नञ् and सु to which the affix कप् -- नद्यृतश्च [[5.4.153]], is added.

6.2.174.e: A बहुव्रीहि समास with बहु has the same accent as नञ् when it denotes muchness of the object expressed by the second member.

6.2.175.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after बहु the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on the final of गुण etc. when they appear in the compound as ingredient of something else.

6.2.176.e: A word denoting a part of the body which is constant (and indispensable) with the exception of पर्शु has after a preposition in a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.

6.2.177.e: After a preposition वन has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in compounds of every kind.

6.2.178.e: After अन्तर् the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the final of वन।

6.2.179.e: The word अन्तर् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by a preposition.

6.2.180.e: The word अन्तर् does not have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after the prepositions नि and वि।

6.2.181.e: After परि a word which expresses something which has both this side and that side, as well as the word मण्डल has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.182.e: After प्र a, a word which does not denote a part of the body has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when the compound is a name.

6.2.183.e: The words निरुदकetc. Have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.184.e: The word मुख has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by अभि।

6.2.185.e: The word मुख has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after the preposition अप्।

6.2.186.e: The words 1. स्फिग 2. पूत 3. वीणा 4. अञ्जस् 5. अध्वम् 6. कुक्षि 6. नामन् and a word denoting 'a plough' have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by the preposition अप्।

6.2.187.e: After अधि that word which denotes that thing which overlaps or stands upon has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.188.e: After अनु a word which is not the Principal as well as कनीयस् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.189.e: After अनु the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the final of पुरुष when it means a man of whom mention was already made.

6.2.190.e: After अति , a word not formed by a कृत् affix and the word पद have acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.

6.2.191.e: After नि the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable when the sense is of 'not laying down'.

6.2.192.e: In a तत्-पुरुष समास the words अंशु etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by प्रति।

6.2.193.e: In a तत्-पुरुष समास the words of two syllables and अजिन् have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by उप but not when they are गौर etc.

6.2.194.e: After सु the second member has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in a तत्-पुरुष समास when reproach is meant, in spite of the addition of सु which denotes praise.

6.2.195.e: In a तत्-पुरुष समास the word उत्पुच्छ may optionally have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.196.e: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the words 1. पाद् 2. दत् and 3. मूर्धन् have optionally acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after द्वि and त्रि।

6.2.197.e: The word सक्थ has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final optionally when preceded by any word other than what ends in क्र।

6.3.1.e: In the following sūtras up to विभाषा स्वसृपत्योः [[6.3.24]], inclusive, is always to be supplied the phrase 'the elision does not take place before the second member of the compound'.

6.3.2.e: The Ablative -5th case-ending after स्तोक etc. is not elided before the second member of a compound.

6.3.3.e: The Instrumental -3rd case endings after 1. ओजस् 2. सहस् 3. अम्भस् and 4. तमस् are not elided before the second member of a compound.

6.3.4.e: After मनस् when the compound is a Name, the Instrumental -3rd case endings are not elided before the second member.

6.3.5.e: Also before आज्ञायिन् the Instrumental -3rd case endings of मनस् are not elided.

6.3.6.e: The Instrumental -3rd case endings after आत्मान् are not elided when an Ordinal Numeral follows.

6.3.7.e: The Dative -4th Case ending is not elided after आत्मान् when the compound is the name of a technical term in grammar.

6.3.8.e: The Locative -7th case ending is not elided after a stem ending in a consonant or a short अ when the compound is a Name.

6.3.9.e: The Locative -7th case affix is not elided after a stem ending in a consonant or a short अ in the name of atax of the Eastern People when the second member begins with a consonant.

6.3.10.e: The Locative -7th case-affix is not elided after मध्य when गुरु follows.

6.3.11.e: is not elided after a word denoting a part of the body (with the exception of मूर्धन् and मस्तक) before every word other than काम।

6.3.12.e: The Locative -7th case-affix is optionally not elided after a word ending in a consonant or अ before बन्ध।

6.3.13.e: In a तत्-पुरुष समास when the second member is a word formed with a कृत् affix the Locative -7th case ending is optionally preserved.

6.3.14.e: The Locative -7th case-affix ending is retained after 1. प्रावट् 2. काल and 3. दिव् when ज follows.

6.3.15.e: The Locative -7th case-affix ending is optionally retained after 1. वर्ष 2. क्षर 3. शर and 4. वर when ज follows.

6.3.16.e: The Locative -7th case-affix ending is optionally retained after a word denoting time ending in a consonant or अ when तरप् or तमप् or the word काल or the affix तन follow.

6.3.17.e: The Locative -7th case-affix ending is optionally retained after the words 1. शय 2. वास and 3. वासिन् when the preceding word does not denote time and ends in a consonant or a short अ।

6.3.18.e: The Locative -7th case ending is not preserved before a stem ending in इन् before he word सिद्ध and before a word derived from बन्ध् ।

6.3.19.e: The Locative -7th case ending is not preserved before स्थ in the spoken language.

6.3.20.e: The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is retained when the compound expresses an 'affront or insult'.

6.3.21.e: The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is optionally retained when insult is meant when पुत्र follows.

6.3.22.e: The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is retained after a word ending in ऋ and expressing a relationship through study or blood.

6.3.23.e: The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is optionally elided after a stem ending in ऋ when 1. स्वसृ and 2. पितृ follow.

6.3.24.e: In a द्वन्द समास of words ending in the short ऋ and expressing relationship through study or blood, the आनङ् is the substitute of ऋ of the first member.

6.3.25.e: The आनङ् is the substitute for the final of the first member in a द्वन्द समास of the names of the देवता-s.

6.3.26.e: For the final of अग्नि is substituted the long ई when 1. सोम or 2. वरुण follow.

6.3.27.e: The short इ is the substitute of the final of the अग्नि in such a द्वन्द समास in which both the members take the वृद्धि।

6.3.28.e: For दिव् is substituted द्यावा in a द्वन्द समास of names of देवता-s.

6.3.29.e: For दिव् is also substituted दिवस् (as well as a द्यावा) when पृथिवी follows in a द्वन्द समास of names of देवता-s.

6.3.30.e: For उषस् is substituted उषासा in a देवता - द्वन्द समास।

6.3.31.e: According to Northern Grammarians मातरपितरौ is a valid form.

6.3.32.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the form पितरामातरा is a valid form.

6.3.33.e: In the room of a feminine word there is substituted an equivalent and uniform masculine form when it is a word which has an actual corresponding masculine and does not end in the feminine affix ऊङ् and is followed by another feminine word in the relation of apposition with it, but not when such subsequent word is an ordinal numeral, nor प्रिय etc.

6.3.34.e: A feminine word not ending in the affix ऊङ् and having an equivalent and uniform masculine is changed into such masculine form, before the affixes beginning with तसिल् etc. -- पञ्चम्यास्तसिल् [[5.3.7]], and ending with कृत्वसुच् -- संख्यायाः क्रियाऽभ्यावृत्तिगणने कृत्वसुच् [[5.4.17]].

6.3.35.e: A feminine word not ending in ऊङ् and having an equivalent and uniform masculine is changed into masculine before the Denominative कयङ् and the affix मानिन्।

6.3.36.e: A feminine word having a penultimate क् does not assume the masculine form.

6.3.37.e: The feminine is not changed to masculine when it is a Name or an Ordinal Numeral.

6.3.38.e: The feminine is not changed into masculine when it is formed by such a तद्धित affix which causes the वृद्धि of the first syllable with exception however of तद्धित-substitute meaning 'coloured therewith' and 'made thereof'.

6.3.39.e: A feminine in ई ending in the name of a part of body does not become masculine except the word मानिन् follows.

6.3.40.e: A feminine noun expressing a class of kind does not become masculine.

6.3.41.e: The feminine (unless it ends in ऊ) having an equivalent and uniform masculine becomes masculine in a कर्मधारय समास and before 1. जातीय and 2. देशीय।

6.3.42.e: Before the affixes 1. तर 2. तम 3. रूप 4. कल्प 5. चेल (with the feminine affix ई) 6. ब्रुव 7. गोत्र 8 मत and 9. हत a word ending in the feminine affix ङी becomes short when the feminine consists of two or more syllables and has an equivalent and uniform masculine.

6.3.43.e: In all the remaining feminine words called नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी [[1.4.3]] and नेयङुवङ्स्थानावस्त्री [[1.4.4]], the substitution of short vowel under the preceding circumstances is optional.

6.3.44.e: The feminine ङी (ई) added to a word formed by a तद्धित affix having an indicatory उ or ऋ is optionally shortened before the घ etc. -- घरूपकल्पचेलड्ब्रुवगोत्रमतहतेषु ङ्योऽनेकाचो ह्रस्वः [[6.3.43]].

6.3.45.e: For the final महत् of is substituted आत् (आ) before a word which is in apposition with it and before जातीय।

6.3.46.e: The words द्वि and अष्टन् get an आकारादेश in presence of a  सङ्ख्याशब्द, provided that there is no बहुव्रीहि समास and the word अशीति is not present.

6.3.47.e: The words त्रि gets an आकारादेश in presence of a  सङ्ख्याशब्द, provided that there is no बहुव्रीहि समास and the word अशीति is not present.

6.3.48.e: The above substitution is the case of all (द्वि , त्रि and अष्टन्) is optional when the word चत्वारिंशत् and the numerals which follow it are the second member.

6.3.49.e: हृद् is substituted for हृदय before लेख and the affixes यत् and अण् and before लास।

6.3.50.e: हृद् is optionally substituted for हृदय before the words शोक and रोग or the affix ष्यङ् follow.

6.3.51.e: पद् is substituted for पाद before 1. आजि 2. आति 3. ग and 4. उपहत।

6.3.52.e: पद् is substituted for पाद before the affix यत् used in any sense other than that of 'suited there to'.

6.3.53.e: पद् is substituted for पाद before 1. हिम 2. काषिन् and 3. हति।

6.3.54.e: पद् is substituted for पाद before the affix शस् when the meaning is that of a ऋक् (Hymn).

6.3.55.e: पद् is optionally substituted for पाद before 1. घोष 2. मिश्र and 3. शब्द।

6.3.56.e: उद is substituted for उदक when the compound is a Name.

6.3.57.e: उद is substituted for उदक before 1. पेषं 2. वास 3. वाह and 4. धि।

6.3.58.e: उद is optionally substituted for उदक before a word beginning with a single consonant and which expresses that which is filled with water.

6.3.59.e: उद is optionally substituted for उदक before 1. मन्थ 2. ओदन 3. सक्तु 4. बिन्दु 5. वज्र 5. भार 6. हार 7. वीवध and 8. गाह।

6.3.60.e: According to the opinion of गालव a short vowel is substituted in a compound before the second member for the long इक् vowels (ई , ऊ , ॠ) unless it is the long vowel of the feminine affix ई (ङी).

6.3.61.e: The short is substituted for the long एका before a तद्धित affix and when a second member follows.

6.3.62.e: The short is diversely substituted for the feminine affixes ई and आ (ङी and आप्) in a Name and in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

6.3.63.e: The feminine affixes ई and आ (ङी and आप्) diversely become short before the affix त्व।

6.3.64.e: For the long vowel a short is substituted in इष्टका before चित in इषीका before तूल and in माला before भारिन्।

6.3.65.e: A short is always substituted for the final of the first member when the second member is a word formed by an affix having an indicatory ख but not when the first member is an indeclinable.

6.3.66.e: मुम् is the augment added immediately after the final vowel of अरुस , द्विषत् and of a stem ending in a vowel unless it is an indeclinable, when the word formed by a खित् affix follows.

6.3.67.e: A monosyllabic word ending in any vowel other than अ when followed by a word formed by a खित् affix receives the augment अम् which is added in the same way as the affix अम् of the Accusative -2nd case singular.

6.3.68.e: वाचंयम and पुरंदर are irregularly formed.

6.3.69.e: मुम् is the augment of सत्य and अगद when the word कार follows.

6.3.70.e: मुम् is the augment of the words श्येन and तिल before पात when the affix ञ् follows.

6.3.71.e: The word रात्रि optionally takes मुम् augment before a word formed by कृत् affix.

6.3.72.e: The न of the Negative Particle नञ् is elided when it is the first member of a compound.

6.3.73.e: After the above न-elided of the Negative Particle नञ् (i.e. after अ) is added the augment नुट् to a word beginning with a vowel.

6.3.74.e: The Negative Particle remains unchanged in - 1. नभ्राज् 2. नपात् 3. नवेदस् 4. नासत्या (dual) 5. नमुचि 6. नकुल 7. नख 8. नपुंसक 9. नक्षत्र 10. नक्र and 11. नाक।

6.3.75.e: The Negative Particle remains unchanged in a word which begins with एक and of this एक there is the augment अदुक् (अद्)।

6.3.76.e: The Negative Particle is optionally retained unchanged in नगो when it does not mean a living animate being.

6.3.77.e: स is substituted for सह , in a Name.

6.3.78.e: स is substituted for सह when it has the sense of 'up to the end'.

6.3.79.e: स is substituted for सह when it is in connection with a word which refers to a second object which latter however is not directly perceived.

6.3.80.e: स is substituted for सह in an अव्ययीभाव समास when the second member is not a word denoting time.

6.3.81.e: स is optionally substituted for सह when the compound is a बहुव्रीहि समास।

6.3.82.e: The word सह retains its original form when the sentence denotes benediction, except when it is गो , वत्स or हल।

6.3.83.e: स is substituted for समान् in the छन्दस् (Vedas), but not before 1. मूर्धन् 2. प्रभृति and 3. उदर्क।

6.3.84.e: This substitution of स for समान् takes place before 1. ज्योतिस् 2. जनपद 3. रात्रि 4. गोत्र 5. रूप 6. स्थान 7. वर्ण 8. वयस् 9. वचन and 10. बन्धु in the common language also.

6.3.85.e: स is substituted for समान् before ब्रह्मचारिन् when it denotes persons engaged in fulfilling a common vow of studying the Vedas.

6.3.86.e: स is substituted for समान् before तीर्थ when the affix यत् is added to it.

6.3.87.e: स is optionally substituted for समान् before उदर when the affix यत् is added to it.

6.3.88.e: स is substituted for समान् before 1. दृग् 2. दृश and the affix वत्।

6.3.89.e: ई is substituted for इदम् and की for किम् before the words 1. दृग् 2. दृश and the affix वत्।

6.3.90.e: आ is substituted for the final of the pronouns - सर्वादीनि सर्वनामानि [[1.1.27]], before the words 1. दृग् 2. दृश and the affix वत्।

6.3.91.e: In the room of the last consonant that follows it, of a pronoun and of the words विषवक् and देव is substituted अद्रि when अञ्च् with the affix व follows.

6.3.92.e: If the 'सम्' उपसर्ग is followed by an लुप्तप्रत्ययान्त-अञ्च् word, then 'सम्'  is converted to 'समि'.

6.3.93.a: अप्रत्यये अलोपे अञ्चतौ उत्तरपदे तिरसः तिरि
6.3.93.e: If the word 'तिरस्' is followed by a  लुप्तप्रत्ययान्त-अञ्च् word from which an अकार has not been removed, then the word 'तिरस्' is converted to 'तिरि'.

6.3.94.e: If the word 'सह' is followed by an लुप्तप्रत्ययान्त-अञ्च् word, then 'सह'  is converted to 'सध्रि'.

6.3.95.e: सध is substituted for सह in the छन्दस् (Vedas) when माद and स्थ follow.

6.3.96.e: After 1. द्वि 2. अन्तर and prepositions, long ई is the substitute of अप्।

6.3.97.e: After अनु , ऊ is substituted for (the अ of) अप् when the sense is that of a locality.

6.3.98.e: अन्य when not used in the Genitive 6th-Case or the Instrumental -3rd case gets the augment दुक् (द्) before 1. आशिस् 2. आशा 3. आस्था 4. उत्सुक 5. कारक and 6. राग as well as before the affix छ (ईय).

6.3.99.e: दुक् (द्) is optionally the augment of अन्य when अर्थ follows.

6.3.100.e: कत् is substituted for कु in a तत्-पुरुष समास when a word beginning with a vowel follows as the second member.

6.3.101.e: कत् is substituted for कु before रथ and वद।

6.3.102.e: कत् is substituted for कु when तृण follows denoting a species.

6.3.103.e: का is the substitute of कु before पथिन् and अक्ष।

6.3.104.e: का is the substitute of कु when the meaning is 'a small'.

6.3.105.e: का is optionally the substitute of कु when the word पुरुष follows.

6.3.106.e: का and कवङ् are optionally the substitutes of कु when उष्ण follows.

6.3.107.e: This substitution of का and कव for कु takes place in the छन्दस् (Vedas) before पथ।

6.3.108.e: The elision, augment and mutation of letters to be seen in पृषोदर etc. though not found taught in the treatises of Grammar, are valid to that extent and in the mode, as taught by the usage of the sages.

6.3.109.a: संख्या-वि-साय-पूर्वस्य उत्तरपदे अह्नस्य ङौ अहन् अन्यतरस्याम्
6.3.109.e: When the word अह्न appears as an उत्तरपद in a समास where the पूर्वपद is either a number, or the words वि or साय, it is optionally converted to अहन् in presence of the प्रत्यय ङि.

6.3.110.e: When a ढकार is deleted due to a ढकार that follows it, or when a रेफ is deleted due to a रेफ that follows the अण् letter occurring before the deleted ढकार/रेफ becomes दीर्घ.

6.3.111.e: For the verbs सह् and वह्, when a ढकार is deleted due to a ढकार that follows it,  the अकार occurring before the deleted ढकार is converted to ओ.

6.3.112.e: 1. साढ्यै 2. साढ्वा and 3. साढा are irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

6.3.113.e: In the following sūtras up to the end of the पाद are to be supplied the words 'in an uninterrupted flow of speech'.

6.3.114.e: Before कर्ण there is the substitution of a long vowel for the final of the preceding word when it denotes a proprietorship mark or the ears of cattle, but not when the words 1. विष्ट 2. अष्टन् 3. पञ्चन् 4. मणि 5. भिन्न 6. छिन्न 7. छिद्र 8. स्रुव and 9. स्वस्तिक।

6.3.115.e: A long vowel is substituted for the final vowel of the preceding word, before the verbs 1. नह् 2. वृत् 3. वृष् 4. व्यध् 5. रुच् 6. सह् and 7. तन् when these roots take the affix क्वि।

6.3.116.e: For the final vowel of कोटर etc. a long vowel is substituted before वन and also of किंशुलक etc. before गिरि when the compound is a name.

6.3.117.e: The final of the preceding word is lengthened before the affix वल।

6.3.118.e: The final vowel of a word consisting of more than two syllables in lengthened before the affix मत् when it is a name, but not of the words अजिर् etc.

6.3.119.e: The final vowel of शर etc. is lengthened before मत् when it is a name.

6.3.120.e: The final इ and the उ of a word with the exception of पीलु are lengthened before वह।

6.3.121.e: The final vowel of a preposition is diversely lengthened before a word formed by the कृत् affix घञ् but not when the compound denotes a human being.

6.3.122.e: A preposition ending in इ or उ lengthens its final before काश।

6.3.123.e: A preposition ending in इ or उ lengthens its final before the verb दा when the latter is changed to त।

6.3.124.e: A long vowel is substituted for the final of अष्टन् before a second member, when the compound is a Name.

6.3.125.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) also, the long vowel is substituted for the final of अष्टन् before a second member.

6.3.126.e: The final word of चिति is lengthened before the affix कप्।

6.3.127.e: The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before वसु and राट् (the form assumed by राज्).

6.3.128.e: The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before नर when the compound is a Name.

6.3.129.e: The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before मित्र when it is the name of a ऋषि।

6.3.130.e: In a मन्त्र the final vowels of 1. सोम 2. अश्व 3. इन्द्रिय and 4. विश्वदेव्य are lengthened when the affix मतुप् follows.

6.3.131.e: In a मन्त्र the final of ओषधि is lengthened before the case-endings but not in the Nominative 1st-Case.

6.3.132.e: In the ऋग्वेद the finals of the particles 1. तु 2. नु 3. घ 4. मक्षु , the tense-affix तङ् , कु the ending त्र and the word उरुष्य are lengthened.

6.3.133.e: In a मन्त्र the finals of the preceding member ending in इ or उ are lengthened before the particle सु।

6.3.134.e: A tense affix ending in अ is lengthened in the ऋग्वेद when the verb consists of two syllables.

6.3.135.e: In the ऋग्वेद the final of a particle is lengthened.

6.3.136.e: The elongation of the final is to be found in other words also.

6.3.137.e: When the अञ्च् word is in a state where its अकार and नकार have been removed, it causes the दीर्घ of the previous अण् letter.

6.4.1.e: In all the rules starting from this sutra till the end of the seventh chapter the word 'अङ्गस्य' should be included while interpreting the sutras.

6.4.2.e: The letter which has been generated using सम्प्रसारणम् and which occurs at end of an अङ्ग becomes दीर्घ when there is a हल् letter which occurs just before it in that अङ्ग.

6.4.3.e: In presence of the   नाम् प्रत्यय, the last letter of the अङ्ग becomes दीर्घ.

6.4.4.e: The words तिसृ and चतसृ do not become दीर्घ in presence of the  नाम् प्रत्यय.

6.4.5.e: In presence of the नाम् प्रत्यय, the last letter of the अङ्ग might or might not be made दीर्घ in वेदाः.

6.4.6.e: In presence of the नाम् प्रत्यय, the last letter of the word नृ becomes दीर्घ optionally.

6.4.7.e: The उपधा of the नकारान्त words becomes दीर्घ when the नकारान्त word is followed by the नाम्-प्रत्यय.

6.4.8.a: नः अङ्गस्य उपधायाः असम्बुद्धौ सर्वनामस्थाने दीर्घः
6.4.8.e: The  उपधा letter of a नकारान्त अङ्ग becomes दीर्घ when followed by a प्रत्यय which is a सर्वनामस्थान other than सम्बोधन-एकवचन.
