6.4.9.a: निगमे षपूर्वस्य नः अङ्गस्य उपधायाः असम्बुद्धौ सर्वनामस्थाने वा दीर्घः
6.4.9.e: When followed by a प्रत्यय which is a सर्वनामस्थान other than सम्बोधन-एकवचन, the उपधा स्वर of a नकारान्त अङ्ग becomes optionally दीर्घ in वेदाः, if that उपधा स्वर is preceded by a षकार.

6.4.10.a: सान्तसंयोगस्य अङ्गस्य, महतः अङ्गस्य नः उपधायाः असम्बुद्धौ सर्वनामस्थाने दीर्घः
6.4.10.e:
The स्वर preceding the नकार from (a) महत् and (b) any word that ends in न्स् - becomes दीर्घ in presence of 
प्रत्यय that is also a सर्वनामस्थान, other than सम्बोधन-एकवचन.

6.4.11.e: The उपधा letter of the words अप्, स्वसृ, नप्तृ, नेष्टृ, त्वष्टृ, क्षत्तृ, होतृ, पोतृ, and प्रशातृ, and also of the words ending in a तृन् or तृच् प्रत्यय becomes दीर्घ in presence of a प्रत्यय that is also a सर्वनामस्थान, other than सम्बोधन-एकवचन.

6.4.12.a: इन्-हन्-पूष-अर्यम्णामङ्गस्य असम्बुद्धौ सर्वनामस्थाने उपधायाः दीर्घः शौ
6.4.12.e: For the words हन्, पूषन् and अर्यमन्, and for also the words that end in 'इन्', the उपधादीर्घ happens only in case of the 'शि' प्रत्यय, and not in case of other सर्वनामस्थानप्रत्ययाः.

6.4.13.a: इन्-हन्-पूष-अर्यम्णामङ्गस्य असम्बुद्धौ सौ सर्वनामस्थाने च उपधायाः दीर्घः
6.4.13.e: For the words हन्, पूषन् and अर्यमन्, and for also the words that end in 'इन्', the उपधादीर्घ happens in case of the सुँ-प्रत्यय of प्रथमा-एकवचन.

6.4.14.a: अधातोः अतु-अस्-अन्तस्य असम्बुद्धौ सौ उपधायाः दीर्घः
6.4.14.e: The उपधा of the words ending in either मत्, वत्, or अस् becomes दीर्घ in presence of the सुँ-प्रत्यय of  प्रथमा एकवचन, provided these words do not end in a धातु.

6.4.15.a: अनुनासिकस्य अङ्गस्य उपधायाः क्वि-झलोः क्ङिति दीर्घः
6.4.15.e: If an अङ्ग ends in an अनुनासिक, the उपधा letter of that अङ्ग  becomes दीर्घ in presence of a क्विप्-प्रत्यय, झलादि-कित्-प्रत्यय and a झलादि-ङित्-प्रत्यय.

6.4.16.e: The lengthening of the vowel takes place in the case of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a vowel, as well as of हन् and गम् when the Desiderative affix सन् being झलादि (i.e. not taking the augment इट्) follows.

6.4.17.e: the lengthened of the अङ्ग (stem) of तन् is optional before the Desiderative सन् when it does not take the augment इट्।

6.4.18.e: The उपधा letter of the verb-root 'क्रम्' undergoes an optional दीर्घादेश when followed by a झलादि क्त्वा प्रत्यय.

6.4.19.e: The last 'त्छ्' of an अङ्ग is converted to 'श्', and the last 'व्' of an अङ्ग is converted to 'ऊठ्' when followed by an अनुनासिकादि or झलादि प्रत्यय that is either कित् or ङित् ।

6.4.20.e: In 1. ज्वर 2. त्वर् 3. श्रिव् 4. अव and 5. मव् before the above mentioned affixes (क्वि and झलादि ङित् and कित् affixes -- अनुनासिकस्य क्विझलोः क्ङिति [[6.4.15]]) there is the single substitution of ऊठ् for the and the vowel preceding the final consonant.

6.4.21.e: After र् there is the elision of छ् and व् before क्वि and झलादि ङित् and कित् affixes -- अनुनासिकस्य क्विझलोः क्ङिति [[6.4.15]].

6.4.22.e: All the sutras present from here onward till the the end of this पाद should be considered as असिद्ध towards each other when they are invoked in such a way that their आश्रयs are exactly the same.

6.4.23.e: After न which is added to the roots of the रुधादिगणः (7th Conjugation) as a गणविकरण - श्नम् (characteristic), there is the elision of the following न।

6.4.24.a: अनिदितां हलः अङ्गस्य उपधायाः क्ङिति नलोपः ।
6.4.24.e: The उपधा नकार of an अङ्ग that is अनिदित् and हलन्त is removed in presence of a कित् or a ङित्-प्रत्यय.

6.4.25.e: The उपधा-नकार of the verbs दंश्, सञ्ज् and स्वञ्ज् is removed in presence of the विकरणप्रत्यय शप् ।

6.4.26.e: The उपधा-नकार of the verb रञ्ज् is removed in presence of the विकरणप्रत्यय शप्.

6.4.27.e: When followed by the घञ्-प्रत्यय in the meaning of  भाव or करण the उपधा-नकार of the verb root रञ्ज् is removed.

6.4.28.e: The word स्यद् is formed by घञ् in the sense of 'speed'.

6.4.29.e: 1. अवोद 2. एध 3. ओद्म 4. प्रश्रथ and 5. हिमश्रथ are irregularly formed by the elision.

6.4.30.e: When used in the meaning of 'to pray', the नकार of the verb root  अञ्च् is not removed.

6.4.31.e: In presence of the क्त्वा प्रत्यय, the  उपधा-नकार of the verb roots  स्कन्द् and स्यन्द् is not removed.

6.4.32.e: The उपधा नकार of the  जकारान्त verb roots and the verb root 'नश्' is optionally removed when followed by the क्त्वा प्रत्यय.

6.4.33.e: The nasal may be optionally elided in भञ्ज before the 3rd person passive of the Aorist in चिण् (ई).

6.4.34.e: Before the Aorist in अङ् and before an affix beginning with a consonant having an indicatory क् or ङ् there is the substitution of ई for the vowel of शास्।

6.4.35.e: The शास्-धातु gets the 'शा' आदेश when followed by the हि-प्रत्यय of लोट्लकार.

6.4.36.e: The 'हन्' धातु gets the 'ज' आदेश when followed by the हि-प्रत्यय of लोट्लकार.

6.4.37.e:
1) For the verb roots that end in an अनुनासिक letter and have an अनुदात्त स्वर in the उपदेश,
2) For the verb root वन्, and
3) For the verb roots that end in an अनुनासिक letter and belong to the तनोत्यादिगण, 

The अनुनासिक is removed when the verb is followed by a झलादि कित् /ङित् प्रत्यय.

6.4.38.e: The nasal above the roots (i.e. अनुदात्त ending in a nasal and वन and तनादि) is optionally elided before the Absolutive affix ल्यप्।

6.4.39.e: Before the affix क्तिच् the above roots (वन and तनादि) neither drop their nasal nor lengthen their root-vowel.

6.4.40.e: The nasal of गम् is always elided before क्वि।

6.4.41.e: A stem ending in a nasal and followed by the affix विट् or वन् always substitutes for long आ for its nasal.

6.4.42.e: The long आ is substituted for the final of जन् , सन् and खन् before the consonant beginning Desiderative affix सन् and before any other affix beginning with a इल् consonant which has an indicatory क् or ङ्।

6.4.43.e: There is optionally the substitution of long आ for the finals of जन् , सन् and खन् before the affix beginning with य and marked with an indicatory क् or ङ्।

6.4.44.e: The long आ is optionally substituted for the final of तन् before the Passive characteristic यक्।

6.4.45.e: The long आ is optionally substituted for the final of सन् before the affix क्तिच् and there is also optional elision of the nasal.

6.4.46.e: From this up to युप्लुवोर्दीर्घश्छन्दसि [[6.4.68]], inclusive, is always to be supplied the words ' before an affix called आर्धधातुक -- आर्द्धधातुकं शेषः [[3.4.114]] etc.'

6.4.47.e: When followed by an आर्धधातुक प्रत्यय, रेफ and the उपधावर्ण of the the verb root gets the 'रम्' आगम.

6.4.48.e: The अ standing at the end of a अङ्ग (stem) is elided before an आर्धधातुक affix.

6.4.49.e: When a consonant precedes the final य in a verbal अङ्ग (stem) this य is also elided before an आर्धधातुक affix.

6.4.50.e: The elision of य of he Denominative अङ्ग (stem) (क्य) is optional when preceded by a consonant and followed by an आर्धधातुक affix.

6.4.51.e: The इ of the verbal अङ्ग (stem) formed with the affix णि is elided before an आर्धधातुक affix which does not take the augment इट् ।

6.4.52.e: The affix णि is elided before the affixes क्त and क्तवतु when these take the augment इट् ।

6.4.53.e: In a मन्त्र the word जनिता is formed irregularly by the elision of णि before the affix तृ with the augment इट् ।

6.4.54.e: शमिता is formed irregularly by the elision of णि before an इट् augmented affix when meaning a sacrificial act.

6.4.55.e: अय् is substituted for the इ of णि before the affixes 1. आम् 2. अन्त 3. आलु 4. आय्य 5. इत्नु and 6. इष्णु।

6.4.56.e: अय् is substituted for the इ of णि before the Absolutive affix ल्यप् when the vowel preceding the इ is light.

6.4.57.e: अय् is optionally substituted for the इ of णि before the Absolutive affix ल्यप् , after the verb आप्।

6.4.58.e: In यु and प्लु , long is substituted for उ in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

6.4.59.e: A long is substituted for the इ of क्षि before the Absolutive affix ल्यप्।

6.4.60.e: A long is substituted for the इ in क्षि before the Past Participle in क्त when it is not in the sense of the future Passive Participle in ण्यत्।

6.4.61.e: The long is optionally substituted for the इ in क्षि before the Past Participle in क्त when it is not in the sense of the future Passive Participle in ण्यत् when the word means 'imprecation' or 'a miserable plight'.

6.4.62.e: Before the affixes 1. स्य (First future and Conditional) 2. सिच् (S-Aorist) 3. सीयुद् (Benedictive) and 4. तासि (Periphrastic Future), when they are used in the भाव (Impersonal) and कर्म (Passive) voices 1. the verbal stems ending in a vowel in the Grammatical system of instruction (उपदेश), as well as the verbs 2. हन् 'to kill' 3. ग्रह् 'to seize' and 4. दृश् 'to see' are treated optionally in the same way as in the 3rd Person of the Passive Aorist in चिण् and when so treated, they have the augment इट् ।

6.4.63.e: युट् is the augment of दीङ् of an आर्धधातुक affix beginning with a vowel and having an indicatory क् or ङ्।

6.4.64.e: The final आ of a root is elided before an आर्धधातुक affix with the augment इट् as well as when it begins with a vowel and has an indicatory क् or ङ्।

6.4.65.e: The final आ of a अङ्ग (stem) is changed into ई before the कृत् affix यत्।

6.4.66.e: For the final of the roots of the form of दा and घा (घु), as well as for that of the roots 1. मा 2. स्था 3. गा 4. पा 5. हा (जुहाति) and 6. सा (सो), there is substituted ई before an आर्धधातुक affix beginning with a consonant which has an indicatory क् or ङ्।

6.4.67.e: ए is substituted for the आ of the above roots (1. मा 2. स्था 3. गा 4. पा 5. हा (जुहाति) and 6. सा (सो)) in the Benedictive Mood Active.

6.4.68.e: For the final आ of any other root than those mentioned in घुमास्थागापाजहातिसां हलि [[6.4.66]], ए may optionally be substituted in the Benedictive active, when the root begins with a conjunct consonant.

6.4.69.e: The ई substitution for आ under sūtra घुमास्थागापाजहातिसां हलि [[6.4.66]] does not apply when the absolutive affix ल्यप् follows 1. मा 2. स्था 3. गा 4. पा 5. हा (जुहाति) 6. सा and 7. घु।

6.4.70.e: इ may optionally be substituted for the आ of मा (मयति) before ल्यप् ।

6.4.71.e: In case of the लुङ्लकार, लङ्लकार and लृङ्लकार, the अङ्ग gets an 'अट्' आगम,  which is also उदात्त.

6.4.72.e: For the लुङ्लकार, लङ्लकार and लृङ्लकार, an अजादि अङ्ग gets an आट्-आगम, which is also उदात्त.

6.4.73.a: छन्दसि लुङ्लङ्लृङ्क्षु अङ्गस्य उदात्तः आडागमः अपि
6.4.73.e: In वेदाः , even the verbs that are not अजादि can be seen to get आट्-आगम for लुङ्लकार, लङ्लकार, and लृङ्लकार.

6.4.74.a: लुङ्-लङ्-लृङ्क्षु माङ् योगे अङ्गस्य अट् आट्  न
6.4.74.e: In presence of the अव्यय माङ्, the अडागमः / आडागमः does not happen even in case of लुङ्लकार, लङ्लकार, and लृङ्लकार

6.4.75.e: In वेदाः, the अडागम आडागम may or may not be seen done in presence of माङ्.

6.4.76.e: रे is diversely substituted for इरे in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

6.4.77.a: अचि श्नु-धातु-भ्रुवाम् य्वोः अङ्गस्य इयङ् उवङौ
6.4.77.e: When followed by an अजादि प्रत्यय,  the ending इवर्ण and the उवर्ण are converted respectively to इयङ् / उवङ् आदेशs for  a) विकरणप्रत्यय श्नु,  b) Any धातु, and  c) The word भ्रू.

6.4.78.e: An  इवर्ण and an उवर्ण occurring at end of an अभ्यास respectively get इयङ् and उवङ् आदेश when followed by an असवर्ण  letter.

6.4.79.e: The word 'स्त्री' gets an इयङ्-आदेश when followed by an अजादि प्रत्यय.

6.4.80.e: The word 'स्त्री' gets an इयङ्-आदेश optionally when followed by अम् प्रत्यय or शस् प्रत्यय.

6.4.81.e: The verb root इण् gets a यणादेश when followed by an अच् letter.

6.4.82.a: अनेकाचः अङ्गस्य असंयोगपूर्वस्य एः धातोः अचि यण्
6.4.82.e: An इवर्ण occurring at end of an a असंयोगपूर्व धातु which in turn occurs at end of an अनेकाच् अङ्ग is converted to यण् letter when followed by an अजादिप्रत्यय.

6.4.83.a: अनेकाचः अङ्गस्य असंयोगपूर्वस्य ओः धातोः सुपि अचि यण्
6.4.83.e: An उवर्ण occurring at end of an a असंयोगपूर्व धातु which in turn occurs at end of an अनेकाच् अङ्ग is converted to यण् letter when followed by a सुप् अजादिप्रत्यय.

6.4.84.e: The word वर्षाभू gets a यणादेश when followed by an अजादि-सुप्-प्रत्यय.

6.4.85.a: भूसुधियोः अङ्गस्य सुपि अचि यण् न
6.4.85.e: The words भू and सुधी do not undergo यणादेश when followed by अजादि सुप् प्रत्यय.

6.4.86.a: छन्दसि भूसुधियोः अङ्गस्य सुपि अचि यण् , न - उभयथा ।
6.4.86.e: In वेदाः, the words भू and सुधी might or might not undergo a यणादेश when followed by an अजादि सुप् प्रत्यय.

6.4.87.a: अनेकाचः अङ्गस्य हुश्नुवोः असंयोगपूर्वस्य ओः अचि सार्वधातुके यण्
6.4.87.e: The उवर्ण of an अनेकाच्-अङ्ग of 'हु' तथा 'श्नु' undergoes a यणादेश, provided that this उवर्ण does not follow a संयोग.

6.4.88.e: The verb root 'भू' gets a वुक् आगम when followed by an अजादि-प्रत्यय of लुङ्लकार or लिट्लकार.

6.4.89.e: When the उपधा of verb root गुह् has a chance of undergoing a गुणादेश while followed by an अजादिप्रत्यय, the गुणादेश is blocked and the उपधा becomes दीर्घ instead.

6.4.90.e: The उपधा letter of the verb root  दुष् is converted to ऊकार when followed by the णिच् प्रत्यय.

6.4.91.a: चित्तविरागे दोषः उपधायाः णौ ऊत् वा
6.4.91.e: To indicate impurification of mind / intellect, the उपधा letter of the verb root दुष् is optionally converted to ऊकार when followed by the णिच् प्रत्यय.

6.4.92.e: The उपधा letter of a मित्संज्ञक अङ्ग becomes ह्रस्व when followed by the णिच् प्रत्यय.

6.4.93.e: Optionally a long may be substituted for the penultimate of the causative of मित् roots, before the third person of the Passive Aorist in चिण् (इ) and before the Absolutive affix णमुल् (अम्).

6.4.94.e: The penultimate of the Causative अङ्ग (stem) is shortened before the affix खच्।

6.4.95.e: The penultimate of the Causative of ह्लद् (ह्लादि) is shortened before the Participle affixes क्त and क्तवतु।

6.4.96.e: The penultimate of चुरादि (10th Conjugation) - छद् is shortened before the affix घ -- पुंसि संज्ञायां घः प्रायेण [[3.3.118]], when not preceded by two prepositions (or more).

6.4.97.e: The penultimate of छादि is shortened before the affixes 1. इस् 2. मन् 3. त्रन् and 4. क्वि।

6.4.98.e: The उपधा letter of the verb roots गम्, हन्, जन्, खन्, घस् is removed when followed by a कित् / ङित् प्रत्यय, except for the अङ् प्रत्यय.

6.4.99.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the root-vowel of तन् and पत् is elided before an affix beginning with a vowel, when it has an indicatory क् or ङ् ।

6.4.100.e: The root-vowel of घस् and भस् is elided in the छन्दस् (Vedas) before any affix whether beginning with a vowel or a consonant which has an indicatory क् or ङ् ।

6.4.101.e: The 'हि' प्रत्यय that follows the verb root 'हु' or a झल् letter is converted to 'धि'.

6.4.102.e: धि is substituted for the Imperative affix हि in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after 1. श्रु 2. शृणु 3. पॄ 4. कृ and 5. वृ।

6.4.103.e: धि is substituted for the Imperative affix हि when the tense-affix is not ङित्।

6.4.104.e: The तिङ् प्रत्यय that follows the चिण् विकरणप्रत्यय undergoes a लुक्.

6.4.105.e: The 'हि' प्रत्यय that follows an अदन्त अङ्ग is removed.

6.4.106.e:
The 'हि' प्रत्यय that follows an उकार is deleted, provided -
a) The उकार occurs at end of a प्रत्यय, and
b) A संयोग is not present immediately before this उकार.

6.4.107.a: अस्य असंयोगपूर्वस्य उतः प्रत्ययस्य म्वोः अन्यतरस्याम् लोपः
6.4.107.e: The उकार which occurs at end of a प्रत्यय is optionally deleted when followed by a मकार / वकार , provided that a संयोग is not present immediately before this उकार.

6.4.108.a: करोतेः अङ्गस्य उतः प्रत्ययस्य म्वोः नित्यं लोपः
6.4.108.e: The उकार occurring at end of a प्रत्यय that is attached to the verb root  कृ is removed when followed by a मकार or a वकार.

6.4.109.a: करोतेः अङ्गस्य उतः प्रत्ययस्य ये नित्यं लोपः
6.4.109.e: The उकार occurring at end of a प्रत्यय that is attached to the verb root कृ is removed when followed by a यकार.

6.4.110.a: उतः प्रत्ययस्य करोतेः अङ्गस्य अतः सार्वधातुके क्ङिति उत्
6.4.110.e: If an अङ्ग of verb root कृ ends in an उकारान्त प्रत्यय, then the अकार of that अङ्ग is converted to उकार when followed by a कित् / ङित् प्रत्यय.

6.4.111.e: The अकार of the 'श्नम्' विकरण and of  the verb root 'अस्' is removed when followed by a सार्वधातुक किति / ङित् प्रत्यय.

6.4.112.a: श्ना-अभ्यस्तयोः अङ्गस्य आतः सार्वधातुके क्ङिति लोपः
6.4.112.e: The आकार of the विकरण श्ना and also of an अभ्यस्त is removed when followed by a सार्वधातुक कित् and ङित् प्रत्यय.

6.4.113.a: श्ना-अभ्यस्तयोः आतः हलि सार्वधातुके क्ङिति ई, अघोः
6.4.113.e: The आकार of the विकरण श्ना and also of an अभ्यस्त is converted to ई when followed by a हलादि सार्वधातुक कित् and ङित् प्रत्यय. But this does not happen for the verb roots that get the term 'घु'.

6.4.114.a: दरिद्रस्य आतः हलि सार्वधातुके क्ङिति इत्
6.4.114.e: The आकार of the verb root 'दरिद्रा' is converted to ह्रस्व-इकार when followed by हलादि-सार्वधातुक कित्/ङित्-प्रत्यय.

6.4.115.a: भियः अङ्गस्य हलि सार्वधातुके क्ङिति इत् अन्यतरस्याम्
6.4.115.e: The last letter of the अङ्ग of verb root 'भी' is optionally converted to ह्रस्व-इकार when followed by हलादि-सार्वधातुक कित्/ङित्-प्रत्यय.

6.4.116.a: जहातेः अङ्गस्य हलि सार्वधातुके क्ङिति इत् अन्यतरस्याम्
6.4.116.e: The verb root 'हा' is converted to ह्रस्व-इकार when followed by हलादि-सार्वधातुक कित्/ङित्-प्रत्यय.

6.4.117.a: जहातेः अङ्गस्य आ, इत् अन्यतरस्याम् हौ
6.4.117.e: The verb root 'हा' gets an optional इकारादेश or an आकारादेश when followed by the प्रत्यय 'हि'.

6.4.118.a: जहातेः अङ्गस्य सार्वधातुके क्ङिति यि लोपः
6.4.118.e: The last letter of हा is removed when followed by a यकारादि प्रत्यय.

6.4.119.e: The घु-संज्ञक verb roots and the verb root अस् get an एकार as आदेश when followed by the 'हि' प्रत्यय. Also, अभ्यास, if present, is removed.

6.4.120.a: एकहल्मध्ये अनादेशादेः अङ्गस्य अतः एत् किति लिटि, अभ्यासलोपः च ।
6.4.120.e: When followed by a कित्-प्रत्यय of लिट्-लकार, The अकारः of an अङ्गम् is converted to एकार, and the अभ्यास is removed; provided that there is no संयोग before as well as after this अकार, and that the first letter of the अङ्गम् is not changed due to any आदेश.

6.4.121.e: ए is substituted for अ of a verbal अङ्ग (stem) standing between two simple consonants, the अङ्ग (stem) not having any different letter substituted in the reduplicate when the ending थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having the augment इट् follows and thereby the reduplicate is elided.

6.4.122.e: ए is substituted for अ of 1. तॄ 2. फल 3. भज and 4. त्रप and the reduplicate is elided when the affixes of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having an indicatory क् (or ङ्) follow, as well as when थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having the augment इट् follows.

6.4.123.e: ए is substituted for आ of राध when meaning 'to hurt someone' and the reduplicate is elided before the affixes क् (or ङ्) or as well as before थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having the augment इट्।

6.4.124.e: ए is optionally substituted for अ of the अङ्ग (stems) 1. जर् (जॄ) 2. भ्रम and 3. त्रस् and the reduplicate is thereby elided before the affixes of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having an indicatory क् (or ङ्)

6.4.125.e: ए is optionally substituted for अ and आ of the seven roots 1. फण् 2. राज् 3. भ्राज् 4. भ्राश् 5. श्लाश् 6. स्याम् and 7. स्वन् and the reduplicate is elided thereby, before the affixes of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having an indicatory क् (or ङ्) as well as before थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having the augment इट्।

6.4.126.e: ए is not substituted for अ of शस् , दद् or of roots beginning with a व् or of such verbal अङ्ग (stems) in which the अ results through the substitution being कित् or ङित् follow, of the सेट् थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) nor is the reduplicate elided.

6.4.127.e: तृ (which is changed to न्त् in the strong cases and forms the feminine in ई unaccented) is substituted for the final of the अङ्ग (stem) अर्वन् , except in the Nominative 1st-Case singular or when the word is joined with the Negative particle.

6.4.128.e: तृ is diversely substituted for the final of मघवन्।

6.4.129.e: All the rules starting from this sutra, till the end of the sixth chapter are being told for a भसंज्ञक.

6.4.130.e: The भसंज्ञक अङ्ग of the word पाद् gets पद् as आदेश.

6.4.131.e: A भसंज्ञक अङ्ग ending in a वसुँ प्रत्यय undergoes सम्प्रसारणम्.

6.4.132.e: भसंज्ञक वाह् is converted to 'ऊठ्' by सम्प्रसारणम्.

6.4.133.e: The भसंज्ञक अङ्ग of  श्वन् , युवन् and मघवन् undergoes सम्प्रसारणम् when followed by a प्रत्यय which is not a तद्धितप्रत्यय.

6.4.134.e: If a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग ends in the word 'अन्' then the 'अ' of this 'अन्' is omitted.

6.4.135.e: The उपधा-अकार of a भसंज्ञकस्य अङ्ग is omitted in presence of an अण्-प्रत्यय, if the अङ्ग ends in one of (1) षन्, (2) हन् or (3) धृतराजन् .

6.4.136.a: अनः भस्य अङ्गस्य अत् ङिश्योः विभाषा लोपः
6.4.136.e: If a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग end in the word 'अन्' and is followed by the ङि or शी प्रत्यय, then the 'अ' of this 'अन्' is omitted optionally.

6.4.137.a: वमन्तात् संयोगात् अनः भस्य अङ्गस्य अत्-लोपः न
6.4.137.e: For a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग which ends in an 'अन्', and also contains a  मकारान्त / वकारान्त संयोगवर्ण before this अन्, the 'अ' of अन् does not get omitted.

6.4.138.e: The अकार of the word अच् that occurs at end of a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग is omitted if this 'अच्' happens to be derived from the धातु अञ्च् (गतौ).

6.4.139.e:
If the word अच् -
(1) happens to be derived from the धातु अञ्च् (गतौ) ,
(2) follows the word उद्,  and
(3) gets the भसंज्ञा, 
 then the अकार of अच् is converted to ईकार.

6.4.140.e: The ending आकार of the भसंज्ञक अङ्ग of an आकारान्त धातु is removed.

6.4.141.e: In the मन्त्र-s , the beginning of आत्मन् is elided when the affix of the Instrumental -3rd case singular follows.

6.4.142.e: The 'ति' of the भसंज्ञक 'विंशति' word is removed.

6.4.143.e: The 'टि'component of a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग is removed when followed by a डित् प्रत्यय.

6.4.144.a: नः भस्य अङ्गस्य टेः तद्धिते लोपः
6.4.144.e: The टिसंज्ञक of a  नकारान्त भसंज्ञक अङ्ग is removed when followed by a तद्धितप्रत्यय.

6.4.145.e: The अ of अहन् is elided only before the affixes ट and ख।

6.4.146.e: An उवर्णान्त भसंज्ञक undergoes a गुणादेश when followed by a तद्धितप्रत्यय.

6.4.147.a: ओः भस्य अङ्गस्य ढे तद्धिते लोपः अकद्र्वाः
6.4.147.e: The last letter of an उवर्णान्त-भसंज्ञक word is removed when followed by a ढकारादि-तद्धितप्रत्यय. But this does not happen for the word 'कद्रू'.

6.4.148.a: भस्य अङ्गस्य यस्य तद्धिते ईति च लोपः
6.4.148.e: The अकार and इकार of a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग is removed when followed by a तद्धितप्रत्यय or an ईकार.

6.4.149.e: Of the भ अङ्ग (stems) 1. सूर्य 2. तिष्य 3. अगस्त्य and 4. मत्स्य (and their derivatives when they are भ) the penultimate य् is also is also elided before a तद्धित affix.

6.4.150.e: The य् of a तद्धित affix when preceded by a consonant and penultimate in a अङ्ग (stem), is elided before the feminine ई।

6.4.151.e: The य् of a Patronymic affix, preceded by a consonant, is elided before a तद्धित when it does not begin with an आ।

6.4.152.e: The य् of a Patronymic affix, preceded by a consonant, is elided before the Denominative affix क्य and the adverbial affix च्वि।

6.4.153.e: The affix छ of the भ अङ्ग (stems) बिल्वक etc. is elided before a तद्धित affix.

6.4.154.e: The affix तृ is elided before the affixes 1. इष्ठन् 2. इमनिव् and 3. ईयसुन्।

6.4.155.e: The last vowel, with the consonant, if any, that follows it, is elided when the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and ईयस् follow.

6.4.156.e: Before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and 3. ईयस् the last semi-vowel is elided with that which follows it and for the first vowel, a गुण is substituted in 1. स्थूल 2. दूर 3. युवन् 4. ह्रस्व 5. क्षिप्र and 6. क्षुद्र।

6.4.157.e: Before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and ईयस् the following substitutions take place 1. प्र for प्रिय 2. स्थ for स्थिर 3. स्फ for स्फिर 4. वर् for उरु 5. बह for बहुल 6. गर् for गुरु 7. वर्ष for वृद्ध 8. त्रप् for तृप् 9. द्राघ for दीर्घ and 10. वृन्द for वृन्दारक।

6.4.158.e: The इ and ई of these affixes (इमन् and ईयस्) are elided after बहु , and for बहु is substituted भू।

6.4.159.e: After बहु , the augment यिट् is added to इष्ठ and भू is the substitute of बहु।

6.4.160.e: आ is substituted for the first letter of ईयस् after ज्य।

6.4.161.e: Before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and 3. ईयस् , र् is substituted for ऋ in a अङ्ग (stem), when this ऋ is preceded by a consonant and is not prosodially long (on account of being followed by a double consonant).

6.4.162.e: Before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and 3. ईयस् , the ऋ of ऋजु may optionally be changed to र् , in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

6.4.163.e: A monosyllabic भ अङ्ग (stem) retains its original form without undergoing any change before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and 3. ईयस् ।

6.4.164.e: The final इन् of a भ अङ्ग (stem) remains unaltered before the non-Patronymic अण् affix.

6.4.165.e: 1. गाथिन् 2. विदथिन् 3. केशिन् 4. गणिन् and 5. पणिन् remain unchanged before the Patronymic also.

6.4.166.e: The syllable इन् of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in इन् remains unchanged before अण् when a conjunct consonant precedes it.

6.4.167.e: The syllable अन् of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in अन् remains unchanged before अण् affix whether Patronymic or otherwise.

6.4.168.e: The syllable अन् of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in अन् remains unchanged before a तद्धित affix beginning with य् when it does not denote existence in abstract of the avocation of someone.

6.4.169.e: The finals of the अङ्ग (stems) आत्मन् and अध्वन् remain unchanged before the affix ख।

6.4.170.e: In a अङ्ग (stem) in अन् with a preceding म् with the exception of वर्मन् , the ending अन् does not remain unchanged before the Patronymic affix अण् ।

6.4.171.e: ब्राह्म is irregularly formed from ब्रह्मन् when not meaning 'a kind of जाति'.

6.4.172.e: कार्म is irregularly formed from कर्मन् by the elision of the final अन् when the sense is 'accustomed to such occupation or prompt therein'.

6.4.173.e: From उक्षन् is formed औक्ष when not meaning a descendant.

6.4.174.e: The following are irregularly formed - 1. दाण्डिनायन 2. हास्तिनायन 3. अथर्वणिक 4. जैह्माशिनेय 5. वाशिनायनि 6. भ्रौणहत्य 7. धैवत्य 8. सरवै 9. अक्ष्वाक 10. मैत्रेय and 11. हिरण्मया।

6.4.175.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the following are irregularly formed 1. ऋत्व्य 2. वास्त्व्य 3. 4. वास्त्व 5. माध्वी and 6. हिरण्यय।
